Record: evidence/planning/governance_flag_adjudication_20260909.md. RESIDUAL: DECISION FOR THE USER, stated cold. MECH-235 says the brain-like arbitration between deliberate planning and habit is continuous, and that unexpected threat pushes it toward habit. REE does have a continuous arbitration weight -- it was built in July and validated -- but it is driven by exactly two quantities: how unfamiliar the current situation is, and how badly the world model has been predicting. Harm plays no part in computing it. A previous governance note proposed settling the question cheaply by re-running an existing experiment while logging the harm signal; a design session on 2026-09-09 read the code and refused, because the weight is a deterministic function of those two inputs, so the answer is arithmetically fixed at zero before any run starts. That refusal is recorded and I have independently confirmed it from the source. THE DECISION IS WHAT TO DO WITH THE CLAIM NOW. OPTION A (the flag's own recommendation) -- keep MECH-235 as a candidate, mark its harm/urgency half as blocked on a substrate build, name the build, and close the older GFLAG-0080 against this record. COST: MECH-235 stays untested for as long as the build is unscheduled, and 'candidate' understates how well-specified the missing piece now is. FORECLOSES: nothing. OPTION B -- do the build now: add a harm-prediction-error term to the arbitrator behind a default-off switch (two concrete shapes are already written out, either about one line of substrate plus a config knob and a bit-identity contract), then run the experiment that becomes possible. OPTION C -- narrow MECH-235 to what the substrate does support, i.e. arbitration on uncertainty rather than on urgency, and drop the harm leg. items.summary: ARC-053's assertion that ascending and descending signals must 'meet in the same phase channel' is under-specified against the anatomy, and this blocks a buildable P_i term. Bastos et al. 2015 (NeuroImage, DCM of macaque V1-V4, PMID 25585017, landed this session at evidence/literature/targeted_review_connectome_arc_053/) shows forward connections are carried predominantly by gamma and backward connections by alpha/beta -- i.e. the two directions occupy DIFFERENT frequency bands by default, so whatever the Temporal Coherence Loop does must be a CROSS-FREQUENCY alignment operation (plausibly phase-amplitude coupling, where descending beta phase gates the window admitting ascending gamma), not the alignment of two signals within one band. Recommended disposition: revise the claim's notes to commit to a cross-frequency formulation before any P_i implementation is attempted. This sharpens rather than contradicts the non-degeneracy precondition already recorded in ARC-053's what_would_answer field.
items.resolution_note: HOLDS-AS-STATED -- edit applied in REE_assembly be59b22b21 (gov-flagbacklog-20260909; user cleared the spot-check gate and approved the docket 2026-09-10). The cited literature entry (evidence/literature/targeted_review_connectome_arc_053/entries/2026-09-09_arc_053_directional_frequency_asymmetry_bastos2015/record.json) is Bastos et al. 2015, NeuroImage, PMID 25585017, DCM of macaque V1-V4 ECoG, landed 2026-09-09T07:02:27Z, direction=mixed, confidence=0.66, and its own text concludes verbatim that 'ARC-053 needs a cross-frequency formulation of "phase channel" before a P_i term can be built against it' -- forward (gamma) and backward (alpha/beta) connections occupy different bands by default. items.summary: ARC-054's notes present 'hippocampal rollout evaluation' as the claim's biological grounding, and the best-designed direct test of that framing comes out against it. Gillespie et al. 2021 (Neuron, PMID 34450026, landed this session at evidence/literature/targeted_review_arc_054/) used a dynamic task purpose-built to dissociate past experience from future choice -- the confound earlier replay-as-planning studies could not break -- and found replay content decoupled from the animal's subsequent choice, instead representing previously rewarded locations. Recommended disposition: revise the notes so the hippocampal-rollout framing is stated as contested rather than settled, and let ARC-054's V3 form carry the weight instead -- it already largely decouples from that substrate (reads MECH-269 per-region V_s walked by the MECH-288 segmenter, per v3_form_note), so V3-EXQ-491 is where the claim should stand or fall. This weakens the claim's GROUNDING, not its computational content: Champion et al. 2022 (PMID 35468491, same directory) independently establishes that horizon-discounted accumulation of a non-reward quantity over a tree of imagined futures is well-posed and tractable, and recovers reward-seeking as a special case -- the generalisation relation ARC-054 asserts.

items.summary: PIPELINE DEFECT (GOV-APPLY-1 ManifestResolver blind spot; the four v3_exq_259 claims are the concrete instance). check_unapplied_autopsy_recommendations.py's ManifestResolver.resolve() returns None for run_id v3_exq_259_wanting_gradient_navigation_1775666895, because that manifest exists ONLY at evidence/experiments/v3_exq_259_wanting_gradient_navigation/<run_id>.json -- inside its experiment-type subdirectory, with no top-level flat copy and no runs/<run_id>/manifest.json pack. The resolver looks only for the flat top-level path and packs. Consequence: _STRUCTURED_REC_CHECKS' recommended_evidence_direction check calls _direction_matches, which cannot see the manifest, returns False, and the four per-claim rows report as unapplied_disposition FOREVER regardless of what the manifest actually says. Verified this cycle: after setting evidence_direction_per_claim to superseded on all four (REE_assembly 676cc9ac62), matching the already-correct run-level superseded, GOV-APPLY-1 still reports all four. The audit's own header quantifies the population: 1208 targets carry a recommended_evidence_direction, of which only 1171 resolve -- so 37 targets are unresolvable this way, not just these. This is a DETECTOR blind spot, not owed governance work; the claim-layer applies are complete. Cross-reference GFLAG-0111, which already names V3-EXQ-259 among the flat-only manifests carrying real scored evidence. Fix direction is the resolver (teach it the experiment-type-subdirectory path), NOT relocating manifests.
items.resolution_note: FIXED in REE_assembly 2d5451429d (chip-20260909-govapply1-manifestresolver-blindspot). The flag's diagnosis was correct but named ONE of TWO coupled causes; neither fix clears the four v3_exq_259 rows alone. (1) RESOLVER, as flagged: ManifestResolver gained step 4 of an explicit precedence list -- a flat-only orphan matched by the run_id FIELD over the indexer's own globs (evidence/experiments/*.json then <experiment_type>/[!_]*.json, runs/ excluded, top-level first), consulted ONLY when the pack and both exact-path flat lookups miss, so it is strictly additive; dry-run smokes are skipped because resolving to one would certify against a manifest the indexer provably never scores. The 2026-08-20 exact-path rule for a PACK's flat sibling is untouched -- a field match is right in step 4 and wrong in steps 2-3, and the class docstring now says why. (2) PROSE ROUTING, not in the flag: _reflects sent the disposition prose '-> evidence_direction: superseded' to the claims.yaml named-field branch, which returns False on 'evidence_direction not in claim' -- true of EVERY claim, since evidence_direction is a manifest field and no claim carried the key. That spelling could never certify whatever the manifest said, and it is the spelling all four v3_exq_259 dispositions use. Both prose spellings now route to the manifest, gated on the same direction vocabulary as the bare form. Strictly additive: the branch was unconditionally False. RESULT: unapplied_disposition 5 -> 1 (all four of ARC-030/MECH-112/SD-012/SD-015 clear; the remaining row is ARC-037 from failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1001_2026-09-04, unrelated and genuine). No claim-layer work was owed -- the 676cc9ac62 applies were already correct. POPULATION: of the flag's 37 unresolvable targets, exactly 2 were this shape (v3_exq_259, and v3_exq_472_sd011_platform_stability_pilot whose flat file is named ..._output.json and is reachable ONLY by the field match); the other 35 have no manifest on disk at all and are now REPORTED under their own named UNRESOLVED line with run_ids rather than folded into the coverage count, so this class cannot hide again. Resolving 472 added one new TRUE finding (its manifest carries no evidence_direction at all). ROOT CAUSE SHARED WITH GFLAG-0111, which STAYS OPEN: 0111 is flat-only manifests written via pack_writer.write_flat_manifest with no write_pack being invisible to scoring; the indexer grew _scan_flat_only_orphans on 2026-09-01 (76921a56ce) to close that, and this audit -- whose whole contract is to follow the indexer -- was not brought along, so 0243 is 0111's defect propagated one repo across. Both v3_exq_259 and v3_exq_472 are present in claim_evidence.v1.json, i.e. the indexer was already scoring them while this audit could not see them. 0111's remaining half is a scoring-semantics choice for /governance, not a code defect. TESTS: 21 new (88 total, all pass), each mutation-checked -- reverting step 4, the prose routing, the dry-run skip, or the UNRESOLVED counter independently reds the suite. --strict / --strict-direction exit contracts unchanged and pinned.

items.summary: FIFTH instance of the GFLAG-0117/0120 dry-run filter blind spot (read GFLAG-0117 first). evidence/experiments/_dry_v3_exq_918a_sd_residue_valence_bound_validation_20260909T062139Z_v3.json is _dry_-PREFIXED (the earlier four instances were _dry-SUFFIXED), has NO top-level dry_run field at all, and carries an ASSERTING stamp: evidence_direction 'supports', outcome PASS, experiment_purpose diagnostic. Because the field is unset, generate_pending_review.load_dry_run_run_ids() does not exclude it and it surfaced in this cycle's pending_review.md as an 'Unclaimed manifest (PASS/FAIL with no claim tags)' inviting a mark-discussed. It is claim-free (claim_ids: []) so nothing is currently weighted, and GOV-DRY-1 Step 3i reported 0 actionable for the same reason -- its asserting-stamp sweep also keys on the unset field. That is the point: the two independent nets that exist for this both miss it by the same mechanism. The prefix variant is new evidence that a filename heuristic is not the fix; the fix is making the driver/stamper emit top-level dry_run: true. Landed 2026-09-09T06:21Z, so a live producer is still emitting the shape.
items.resolution_note: PRODUCER FIXED at the writer: ree-v3 5181e49613 (2026-09-09) makes pack_writer.write_flat_manifest set top-level dry_run: true whenever it applies the _dry_ filename marker, mirroring the write_pack block that got this on 2026-07-28 and left the flat path behind. Root cause was NOT two conventions but one writer gap surfacing through two: V3-EXQ-918a (_dry_-PREFIXED, this writer's marker) and the still-live V3-EXQ-324d (_dry-SUFFIXED, baked into run_id at the driver) BOTH thread dry_run=True into that call and neither set the field itself, so one fix covers both. Confirms the flag's own reading that a consumer-side filename heuristic is the wrong fix -- reinforced by 78 manifests carrying dry_run:true with no filename marker at all. Guarded to never clobber an explicit caller value (V3-EXQ-365/608/632 set it themselves) and never add the key on a real run. Deliberately NOT a manifest_core ALWAYS_CORE/MANDATORY_CORE key: both assert PRESENCE on every manifest and dry_run must be ABSENT on a real run; unlike the 2026-09-09 flat-scalar-readout check (advisory because the corpus gap was too large) dry_run IS always computable at the writer. Regression contract: ree-v3 tests/contracts/test_flat_manifest_dry_run_field.py, 6 tests, negative-controlled. Verified full ree-v3 suite on the hub: 5897 passed / 44 skipped / 1 xfailed / 215 subtests, exit 0. CORPUS SWEEP (report only, nothing stamped): 41 files / 29 distinct run_ids carry a dry filename marker with no dry_run field (2 flat, 27 typedir, 12 pack); 18 carry an ASSERTING evidence_direction against SD-011/013/015/019/020/021/022, MECH-090/112/163, ARC-028/030, Q-036. NONE is currently weighting a claim -- zero of the 29 appear anywhere in claim_evidence.v1.json (lookup sanity-checked against the real run ids for the same experiment types), because sync_v3_results._is_dry_run already carries filename arms for both conventions. But 14 are already in reviewed_run_ids, i.e. a past session mark-discussed a smoke -- the exact failure mode this flag predicted. NOT RESOLVED BY THIS WORK: GFLAG-0117's consumer-side half stays open on its own merits -- 27 of the 41 are the typedir shape (<type>/<run_id>.json) that generate_pending_review and check_dry_run_adjudication_leak still do not enumerate; the writer fix and the glob widening are complementary and neither alone makes those 27 visible.

items.summary: ROUTED TO /failure-autopsy by governance cycle governance-20260909 wave 3 (user decision; this flag is the autopsy target, and GFLAG-0195 was resolved pointing here). V3-EXQ-900 (v3_exq_900_sd024_da_cluster_allocation_representational_functional_20260808T103846Z_v3) is a reviewed, non-degenerate, claim-tagged evidence PASS whose own label asserts more than its criteria test. Its combination rule is 'PASS iff C1 AND C2 AND C4', and ALL THREE load-bearing criteria are representational or absence-based: C1 is Spearman rho(dopamine_signal, cluster_size)=0.5327, C2 is rho(cluster_size, density_reader)=0.5166, and C4 is a negative existential (0 cluster allocations across 1403 live harm calls). NOTHING in the rule tests the FUNCTIONAL half of 'da_cluster_allocation_representational_AND_functional'. The one functional discriminator the run does record is FLAT and ungated: mean_benefit_magnitude_across_cluster_sizes_ge2 = 0.5577261900901794 versus mean_benefit_magnitude_across_cluster_size_1 = 0.5582475601224338, a difference of about 0.09 percent, sitting in the pooled block with no criterion attached. Second finding: the readiness floor R3 pooled_live_expansion_events cleared by exactly ONE event (measured 6.0, threshold N_EXPANSION_MIN=5), and mean_cluster_size is 1.3158 with max 8, so the entire cluster-expansion arm rests on 6 events. What the skim CLEARS, so the autopsy need not re-derive it: the thresholds are pre-registered and explicitly NOT derived from this run's statistics (RHO_LIVE_MIN=0.30, cleared by ~1.7x on both correlations, attainable in either direction); C4 is well powered; non_degenerate: true comes from a real input-spread check on cluster_size and density, not from a count floor. THE ASK: adjudicate whether the flat benefit-magnitude readout falsifies, qualifies, or is simply out of scope for SD-024's functional clause, and whether a 6-event expansion arm can carry it. Until that is answered SD-024 stays candidate and is NOT promoted despite reading confirmed_established at experimental_confidence 0.704 with zero conflicting runs. SEPARATELY, and independent of the above: V3-EXQ-795, the second run cited in support of SD-024, is a DIAGNOSTIC PASS with NO confirmed failure_autopsy artifact (verified 2026-09-09 via check_autopsy_coverage.py), so under the Step 1.5a rule it cannot count toward any promotion; it is also tagged SD-025, which inherits the same problem.
items.resolution_note: RESOLVED 2026-09-14 by failure-autopsy: REE_assembly evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-900_2026-09-14.{json,md} (commit 22d1bf1564, on origin/master). GFLAG-0246's cited evidence (flat mean_benefit_magnitude_across_cluster_sizes_ge2 vs cluster_size_1, ~0.09% gap) is confirmed uninformative: benefit_magnitude is the near-constant environmental reward input (CV ~1.6% across all 57 pooled events) multiplied by the genuinely variable drive_level (34x range) to form dopamine_signal; a magnitude-keyed split was never going to discriminate by construction. This does NOT falsify SD-024. BUT the flag's underlying worry -- 'nothing in the rule tests the functional half' -- is SUBSTANTIALLY VALIDATED via a different, more serious route than the flag itself named, caught by an adversarial cross-model red-team pass (redteam_failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-900_2026-09-14.md, same commit): the manifest's own recorded C2_cluster_size_vs_density criterion (0.5166, PASS) is computed on density_delta, NOT the pre-registered raw density the driver's own 'PRE-REGISTERED ACCEPTANCE' docstring section names (lines 97-100/155-157). Recomputed directly from per_seed_rows: rho(cluster_size, RAW density) = 0.1775, below RHO_LIVE_MIN=0.30 on this run's own live sample. density_delta is substantially an arithmetic function of cluster_size and fixed RBF jitter/bandwidth geometry (single-center delta = 1.0 to 6 decimals for 51/51 events; per-cluster delta matches the jitter-kernel expectation ~0.49/center almost exactly), so it is closer to a re-run of the P0 synthetic sweep (R2, rho=1.0) than an independent live test of propagation into the standing density signal SD-025's curiosity drive actually reads (per field.py's own compute_local_density docstring). This is independently corroborated by GFLAG-0249 (already resolved, same cycle), which names this exact V3-EXQ-900/GFLAG-0246 instance verbatim and defers 'whether the bar turns out unattainable may invalidate the run's VERDICT' to a future governance decision -- this autopsy IS that decision: does not invalidate C1(representational)/C4(asymmetry), does invalidate the label's functional half and claims.yaml's current C2 note ('measured 0.517', stated without noting it is the delta figure). VERDICT: PASS stands as narrow_supports (C1+C4 only, both leave-one-out robust); SD-024 stays candidate; claims.yaml evidence_quality_note should be updated per the artifact's recommended_evidence_quality_note. Recommended future work (not queued from this autopsy; governance chips once ratified): a redesign operationalizing functional propagation via a standing/delayed density read plus a benefit_magnitude sweep at pinned drive_level (the axis Duvelle 2019 and the substrate's linear formula make opposite predictions on). V3-EXQ-795's separate diagnostic-PASS-without-autopsy concern is out of scope for this single-target dispatch and is independently surfaced by pending_review.md for the next /governance cycle.

items.summary: CROSS-CUTTING ATTRIBUTION GAP -- recorded once by governance cycle governance-20260909 wave 3 (user decision) as the single owner of a defect that GFLAG-0193, GFLAG-0191 and GFLAG-0202 each describe one instance of. Those three flags are DELIBERATELY LEFT OPEN pointing here rather than resolved, because the underlying defect is unfixed. THE SHAPE: a diagnostic experiment correctly carries claim_ids: [] (the deliberate convention that stops a diagnostic weighting a claim), the run then PASSes cleanly and is confirmed and reviewed, and the claim it actually validates is left reading as evidence-free -- so a validated design decision is indistinguishable, to every downstream consumer, from one nobody ever tested. THE THREE INSTANCES: (i) SD-084 is status candidate_substrate_landed with evidence: [] and returns null from claim_evidence.v1.json, while its validating diagnostic V3-EXQ-839 PASSed cleanly (415 vs 0, attributability 4/4 as pre-registered, negative control held, non_degenerate), was CONFIRMED by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-839_2026-07-30, and was ratified by governance on 2026-08-10. (ii) MECH-288 sits at experimental_confidence 0.649 from genuine_exp_count 1 (V3-EXQ-757, an action-free synthetic isolation test) while its substrate ran live inside 22 further indexed experiments, none of which names MECH-288 in claim_ids. (iii) V3-EXQ-694 (v3_exq_694_sd061_difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy_readiness) is a reviewed PASS with claim_ids: [], is the ONLY exercise of the SD-061 substrate, and its entropy result (ON-arm first_action_entropy fell -0.0812/-0.0734/-0.0953 on 3/3 seeds while control drift was mixed in sign) is load-bearing for BOTH MECH-343 and MECH-527 -- currently attributable to neither. WHY THIS NEEDS A DECISION RATHER THAN THREE EDITS: the honest fix is not to back-tag claim_ids on diagnostics (that would defeat the convention and let diagnostics weight claims, which is the thing the convention exists to prevent). It is a cross-tag mechanism that records 'this diagnostic validated that claim' WITHOUT granting scored credit -- exactly what the ARC-120 and ARC-130 claim_synthesis passes did by hand in 2026-09-07, and what diagnostic_evidence_adjudicated: true marks after the fact. The open question for governance is whether that hand pattern should become a standing, mechanised route, and if so what reads it. Until then every validated-but-untagged claim will keep re-surfacing as a promotion_review flag, one claim at a time, forever.
items.resolution_note: USER-APPROVED DECISION applied 2026-09-10 in REE_assembly c8116c399b (gov-flagbacklog-20260909; user read the docket and approved the recommendation). All three named instances verify exactly as stated: SD-084 evidence:[]/claim_evidence.v1.json=null despite V3-EXQ-839 PASS+CONFIRMED+ratified (see GFLAG-0193); MECH-288 experimental_confidence=0.649 from genuine_exp_count=1 while ~22 other runs exercise its substrate untagged (see GFLAG-0191); V3-EXQ-694 is a reviewed PASS with claim_ids=[] and is SD-061's only exercise, load-bearing for both MECH-343 and MECH-527, both absent from claim_evidence.v1.json (see GFLAG-0202). New corroborating finding: V3-EXQ-839's own manifest already carries a bears_on:[SD-084,...] field, but build_experiment_indexes.py never reads any 'bears_on' key (zero grep hits) -- the exact plumbing this flag asks governance to consider already exists in one producer and is inert. The proposed precedent (evidence_direction_per_claim stamped by hand, claim_ids left untouched) is independently confirmed as already-used practice: commits 5a56e04ad6 and d0f11e8e6a (both dated 2026-09-07) did exactly this for ARC-120 and ARC-130. DECISION AS APPLIED: This is the parent governance decision for the whole cluster (per its own text, correctly so). OPTIONS: (a) status quo. (b) back-tag claim_ids on diagnostics -- explicitly rejected in the flag's own reasoning, and independently confirmed here to conflict with the CLAUDE.md claim_ids Accuracy Rule. (c) build a mechanised bears_on/cross-tag reader in build_experiment_indexes.py that surfaces but does not score these attributions -- the field already exists unread on at least one manifest (V3-EXQ-839), and the manual equivalent (evidence_direction_per_claim with claim_ids untouched) is already established governance practice from the 2026-09-07 ARC-120/ARC-130 passes. RECOMMENDATION: (c) -- wiring the indexer to read the already-present bears_on field (or formalising the evidence_direction_per_claim-without-claim_ids pattern) would resolve GFLAG-0191/0193/0202 in one mechanism and prevent this from recurring 'one claim at a time, forever' as the flag itself puts it. Record: evidence/planning/governance_flag_adjudication_20260909.md. RESIDUAL: Cross-cutting flag explicitly raised as a user-decision item by governance-20260909 wave 3. Verified as the correct parent for GFLAG-0191/0193/0202; all facts check out and one new supporting fact (the dormant bears_on field) was found during this adjudication.

items.summary: CORRECTS the GFLAG-0244 resolution note, and records a MEASURED residual the 0244 framing missed. GFLAG-0244's producer fix is sound and stands (ree-v3 5181e49613: pack_writer.write_flat_manifest now sets top-level dry_run:true with the _dry_ filename marker). But its resolution note asserted that GFLAG-0117's consumer-side half was still open, with 27 typedir manifests unreachable by the enumerators. THAT IS WRONG and should not be relied on: the three-shape enumerator (flat, typedir, pack) landed 2026-09-07 in generate_pending_review.py and check_dry_run_citations imports it, so all three shapes ARE enumerated. THE REAL RESIDUAL, measured live 2026-09-09 by running the corpus through the live consumer rather than reasoning about it: two dryness checks over the same corpus have DIFFERENT ARMS. sync_v3_results._is_dry_run has THREE -- (1) dry_run field truthy, (2) flat_path.name.startswith('_dry_'), (3) run_id.endswith('_dry'). generate_pending_review._is_dry_run has TWO -- the field, and _DRY_RUN_ID_RE = re.compile(r'_dry_[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z') which REQUIRES a timestamp. A bare trailing _dry (no timestamp) passes the regex, and a _dry_-PREFIXED filename with a clean run_id is structurally invisible because _is_dry_run(d: dict) never receives the path. CONSEQUENCE: of 41 dry-named manifests carrying no top-level dry_run field, 26 are excluded by the timestamped regex and 15 LEAK PAST EVERY ARM. 14 of the 15 carry an ASSERTING evidence_direction (13 does_not_support, 1 supports) against the claims tagged here. This is why the two checks disagreed in the field: sync kept ALL of them out of claim_evidence.v1.json (verified: 0 of 29 affected run_ids appear there, lookup sanity-checked against the real run ids for the same experiment types), while pending_review and GOV-DRY-1's asserting-stamp sweep did not. NOTHING IS CURRENTLY MIS-SCORED -- latent trap, not active mis-weighting -- but 14 of the affected run_ids are ALREADY IN reviewed_run_ids, i.e. a past session mark-discussed a smoke, which is the failure mode GFLAG-0244 predicted and which has therefore already occurred. THE 15: _dry_v3_exq_918a_sd_residue_valence_bound_validation_20260909T062139Z_v3.json (supports; the filename-prefix case), v3_exq_324b_sd020_harm_surprise_pe_dry.json, and the _dry-suffixed typedir manifests under v3_exq_259, 318, 319, 320, 321, 321a, 322, 322a, 323 (supports), 323a, 324, 325, 325a. ROUTING: the CODE half is chipped as chip-20260909-isdryrun-parity-gap (task_bcfa6431) -- bring generate_pending_review._is_dry_run to arm-parity, which zeroes the leak with no corpus write and is strictly preferable to stamping. The CORPUS half is governance's call and is NOT chipped: if any of the 15 warrants a quarantine stamp, only superseded / non_contributory are safe values, and the 14 reviewed_run_ids entries may want revisiting. NOTE the parity fix must not be read as re-legitimising a filename heuristic AS THE FIX -- GFLAG-0244's point stands that the source is the writer; this is the historic-corpus half, and the two are complementary, not alternatives.
items.resolution_note: SUPERSEDED 2026-09-10 by the gov-flagbacklog-20260909 adjudication (record: evidence/planning/governance_flag_adjudication_20260909.md). This flag's CODE half is discharged: chip-20260909-isdryrun-parity-gap landed as REE_assembly 9dc856c100 (generate_pending_review._is_dry_run brought to arm-parity; leak 15 -> 0), followed by 7368bc7fb4 bringing four remaining independent re-spellings onto the canonical predicate. Its CORPUS half remains genuine but its stated urgency rests on an assertion that is FALSE: the flag says '14 of the affected run_ids are ALREADY IN reviewed_run_ids ... which has therefore already occurred'. items.summary: PIPELINE / RECORDING-STANDARD DEFECT, corpus-wide (the four named claims are instances this cycle tripped over, not the scope). MEASURED 2026-09-09 across all non-dry flat manifests in evidence/experiments/: of 534 manifests that declare a load-bearing criteria list, 486 (91.0 percent) record ZERO load-bearing criteria carrying BOTH a measured value and a threshold -- not merely some missing, none at all -- and 180 of those 486 are outcome PASS. Only 40 (7.5 percent) are fully re-derivable. Separately, 489 carry no combination_rule at all. CONSEQUENCE, and why this is a governance problem and not a tidiness one: a criterion recorded as passed: true with no measured value and no bar cannot be checked from the manifest, so the /governance Step 2b MANDATORY DRIVER SKIM -- specifically its 2026-08-30 threshold-arithmetic clause, 'given the magnitudes this run actually measured, is the bar attainable in both directions, or does one branch fire BY CONSTRUCTION' -- cannot be discharged by reading the artifact. It requires opening the driver source every time. That is exactly how V3-EXQ-936a's absolute bar, ~7,900x above the maximum attainable effect, was logged clean for three consecutive cycles. This cycle alone the gap forced a driver read three separate times, and each read found something the manifest could not have shown: V3-EXQ-900's PASS label asserts a FUNCTIONAL half that no criterion tests while the one functional discriminator recorded is flat to 0.09 percent (GFLAG-0246); V3-EXQ-642b's C1/C2 read a DV clamped at 1.5 in both arms so the separation is 0.0 by construction (GFLAG-0141, already autopsied); V3-EXQ-231a's C2 is an arithmetic consequence of its C1 under the driver's own linear map, so it cannot fail when C1 passes (GFLAG-0163, MECH-106 demoted on it). None of those three were visible in the manifest. SUGGESTED DIRECTION, not prescribed: this is the same shape as the flat-scalar-readout gap the Experimental Recording Standard v0.2 closed on 2026-09-09 (REE_assembly d2da351f03, ree-v3 f204ee02ce), and the precedent there is instructive in BOTH directions -- that check was deliberately made ADVISORY in every mode, including --strict, precisely because the corpus gap was too large to gate on (802 of 1008 flat manifests lacked the field). A 91 percent gap is larger still, so a blocking gate is not the move; an advisory validate_recording check plus a standard section requiring measured + threshold on every load-bearing criterion, forward-only, is. Whether the 180 already-PASSING manifests get backfilled is a separate and much bigger question that should NOT be assumed.
items.resolution_note: CLOSED by Experimental Recording Standard v0.3 (REE_assembly bc3d93e61a, on origin/master) + the two advisory checks (ree-v3 ef2bcb2b74, on origin/main). (1) Standard sec 3b gains 'Re-derivable criteria': every LOAD-BEARING criterion must record its MEASURED value and its THRESHOLD as separate machine-readable numeric fields (not prose), plus combination_rule when more than one is load-bearing. (2) validate_recording.check_criteria_thresholds (written manifest; verdicts none_rederivable / partial / criteria_unrecorded / combination_rule_only) and validate_experiments.criteria_threshold_lint (AST, on the driver's load-bearing criterion literals), registered as check 'criteria_threshold' and run by default. (3) ADVISORY IN EVERY MODE including --strict and --paths, pinned by contract class CriteriaNeverBlocksUnderStrict -- the flat-scalar-readout precedent, applied for the same reason. (4) Tests: 14 new contracts in ree-v3/tests/contracts/test_criteria_threshold_lint.py plus 3 classes in test_validate_recording.py; full ree-v3 suite green on the hub (5945 passed, 44 skipped, 1 xfailed, exit 0). MEASUREMENT CORRECTION, recorded in the standard's v0.3 GOV-HELDOUT-1 section: this flag's headline figures (534 manifests / 486 at 91.0 percent / 180 PASS / 40 re-derivable / 489 no combination_rule) did NOT reproduce -- sweeping evidence/experiments/ no definition yields a 534 denominator (the widest construction, flat plus pack manifests carrying either criteria or a combination_rule, gives 233). Reproducible figures under a stated predicate: of 983 live flat manifests, 216 carry a load-bearing criteria set and 184 of those (85.2 percent) record NOT ONE criterion carrying both halves, 53 of them outcome PASS; 32 fully re-derivable; 133 of 216 have more than one load-bearing criterion and no combination_rule. THE PHENOMENON IS CONFIRMED and all four named runs are exactly as described -- only the magnitude differs. GOV-HELDOUT-1 run: CAUGHT AN OVER-BROAD RULE TWICE (a literal spelling list flagged 26 criteria across 14 genuinely-compliant manifests; and scoping to load_bearing:true alone exempted the corpus's worst shape, 101 bare name-to-bool maps, by construction). STILL OPEN, DELIBERATELY OUT OF SCOPE AND LEFT TO GOVERNANCE: back-filling the 53 already-PASSING manifests this check flags -- a criterion whose bar turns out unattainable may invalidate the run's VERDICT, not merely its recording, so it needs a governance decision rather than a recording-standard amendment. Recommendation recorded in the standard sec 4: triage those 53 by claim load-bearingness first. No claim status and no evidence_direction was changed by this work.

items.summary: BACK-FILL TRIAGE owed by the GFLAG-0249 fix -- a DECISION for governance, not a recording task, and it currently has no owner (GFLAG-0249 is resolved, so nothing re-derives it; the named claims are the highest-count instances, not the scope). The Experimental Recording Standard v0.3 (REE_assembly bc3d93e61a) now requires every LOAD-BEARING criterion to record its MEASURED value and its THRESHOLD as separate machine-readable numeric fields, and the two checks that enforce it are ADVISORY ONLY (ree-v3 ef2bcb2b74) -- deliberately, since 184 of 216 flat manifests carrying load-bearing criteria record none that is re-derivable (85.2 percent). Advisory enforcement fixes the FORWARD flow and changes nothing about what is already landed. MEASURED 2026-09-09 with the shipped check over 983 live flat manifests: 53 manifests with outcome PASS record NOT ONE load-bearing criterion carrying both a bar and a measured value, spanning 40 distinct claims -- and 35 of those 53 carry evidence_direction: supports, i.e. they are actively supporting a claim on criteria that CANNOT BE RE-CHECKED FROM THE ARTIFACT. THE QUESTION GOVERNANCE MUST DECIDE: this is not merely a recording gap, because a criterion whose bar turns out to be unattainable invalidates the run's VERDICT, not only its documentation. V3-EXQ-936a (MECH-439) is the proven instance -- an absolute bar ~7,900x above the maximum attainable effect, PASS, logged clean for three consecutive governance cycles; its C2 could not have failed. The same shape may sit undetected in any of the other 52. RECOMMENDATION, not a prescription: triage the 53 by claim load-bearingness first rather than back-filling wholesale -- most will be inert (a re-derivable-looking PASS whose bar was in fact attainable), and a handful will be 936a-shaped and need the run's evidence_direction revisited. Reproduce the list with: validate_recording.check_criteria_thresholds over evidence/experiments/*.json, keeping outcome PASS with verdict none_rederivable or partial. NOTE ON THIS FLAG'S PROVENANCE: GFLAG-0249's own headline figures (534 manifests / 486 / 91.0 percent / 180 PASS) did not reproduce under any definition; the figures here are from the shipped check and are reproducible from the predicate stated above. The phenomenon was confirmed exactly as GFLAG-0249 described it; only the magnitude differs.

items.summary: Three of MECH-349's what_would_answer criteria are NOT SATISFIABLE as written against the substrate they name, measured 2026-09-11 while building its owed GFLAG-0198 validation run. (1) Precondition (b)'s distinctness test 'crf_max_pairwise_rule_dist >= 1.5' is an arithmetic identity, not a measurement: under the mature-pool + availability_maintenance stack nothing ever retires, so slots fill contiguously and the statistic is a deterministic lookup on live-rule count off the fixed pinned_seed=6063 direction matrix -- the 1.5 floor is exactly 'live_rules >= 3'. Verified by reproducing 8/8 observed values from the rule count alone. This also makes MECH-350's headline diagnostic structurally uninformative in this configuration. (2) Precondition (b)'s non-churn conjunct and FALSIFYING(3) (the V3-EXQ-666c 302-minted/302-retired/dist-0.0 churn signature) are UNREACHABLE: a rule mints at maintenance_floor 0.45, the silence decay is skipped, maintenance_decay is 0.0, and a rule that stops activating freezes rather than decaying because eligibility is only set while active -- so crf_n_retired_total is 0 at outcome signal +0.1, 0.0, -0.1 and -1.0 (only the sign is read). Testing churn requires maintenance_floor below mature_retire_floor. (3) CONFIRMING(2)'s regime-count contrast cannot be run as specified: under cue_centering a 1-regime ecology is annihilated by the common-mode baseline, so the centered residual collapses to observation noise, the leading-8-dim sign bucket fragments into up to 255 buckets, and the 1-regime variant mints MORE rules than a multi-regime one rather than holding at the predicted 1-2; and mint count is NON-MONOTONIC in regime count (n_regimes 4/8/16/24 gave mean live rules 26.6/15.8/18.2/25.0, uncensored at n_slots=128). Mechanism behind all three: CandidateRuleField._maybe_mint increments its (context-bucket, action-object) counter and never resets it or marks the key minted, so once a key clears threshold it mints on EVERY subsequent tick until the context-cosine mint-block or slot exhaustion stops it -- the mint-block, not the counter, is what bounds the pool. Suggested reconciliation: restate (b) as a structural fact for this stack, and replace CONFIRMING(2)'s regime-count contrast with a mint-block threshold sweep.

items.summary: MECH-349 clause (ii) -- 'no existing rule's context_tag already covers it' -- is NOT TESTABLE in any ecology of well-separated context regimes, measured 2026-09-11 by instrumenting the mint-block while driving ree_core/policy/candidate_rule_field.py directly. At the substrate's own default crf_mature_mint_block_threshold of 0.8, the block fired 190 times in a 254-tick run and EVERY SINGLE FIRE was at cosine exactly 1.000 -- a regime blocking ITSELF on re-presentation after it had already minted. Cross-regime blocks: ZERO. The reason is structural: the maximum attainable centered cosine between distinct regime directions was 0.5294 (0 of 120 pairs reach 0.8), so no genuinely different regularity can ever be judged 'already covered' at the operating threshold. Lowering the threshold does make the gate fire across regimes (18 cross-regime blocks at 0.5, 62 at 0.2) but those are FALSE blocks of regularities that are distinct by construction, so a mint-count response to the threshold measures the gate mis-firing, not coverage detection. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE CLAIM: any experiment that sweeps the mint-block over separated regimes can demonstrate parameter sensitivity but cannot evidence clause (ii); reading such a sweep as support would be a vacuous positive. WHAT WOULD ACTUALLY TEST IT: an ecology containing PARTIALLY OVERLAPPING regimes -- context directions deliberately placed at centered cosines that straddle the block threshold (roughly 0.6 to 0.95) -- so that 'a distinct regularity an existing rule already covers' is a state the ecology can actually present. Separately, MECH-349 CONFIRMING(1)'s first half ('the measured recurrence count at mint is >= 3 on 100% of mint events') is an ARITHMETIC TAUTOLOGY of the implementation and cannot fail: CandidateRuleField._maybe_mint increments the recurrence counter and then early-returns when it is below threshold, so a sub-threshold mint is unreachable for any substrate of that shape. Only CONFIRMING(1)'s second half, the threshold sweep, has empirical content. Raised while building the owed GFLAG-0198 validation run; see GFLAG-0265 for three further non-satisfiable criteria on the same claim.

items.summary: MECH-349 may not be an EMPIRICAL claim in its current form, and governance should adjudicate that before another session is asked to validate it. Four independently-designed experiments were built for it on 2026-09-11 and all four were killed by adversarial design review, each for a DIFFERENT structural reason, and the common root is that the claim's CREATE-face assertions restate the implementation rather than predicting anything the implementation could fail to do. Concretely: (1) clause (i) 'recurs at least threshold times' -- CandidateRuleField._maybe_mint increments its recurrence counter and then early-returns below the bar, so 'the measured recurrence count at mint is >= threshold on 100% of mint events' (CONFIRMING(1)'s first half, verbatim) is an arithmetic tautology that no substrate of that shape can violate; all that remains testable is parameter sensitivity, i.e. that mint count responds when the knob moves. (2) clause (ii) 'not already covered by an existing rule's context_tag' is only testable in an ecology that can PRESENT a distinct-but-covered regularity; in separated-regime ecologies it never fires cross-regime at the operating threshold (GFLAG-0266), and in an overlapping-cluster ecology built to present it, the natural criterion ('every near-twin refused' = mints equal distinct clusters) turns out to be algebraically identical to the non-degeneracy precondition that guards it, so it cannot fail in any scored manifest while the substrate that WOULD falsify it fails the precondition and is filed as substrate-not-ready with no claim row at all. (3) The claim explicitly disclaims the downstream consequences that would make it falsifiable -- 'NOT FALSIFYING. A null on any downstream committed-action or behavioural DV' -- routing those to MECH-439's conversion ceiling. So the claim asserts a mechanism whose trigger conditions are true by construction and whose observable effects are out of scope. SUGGESTED DISPOSITION, for governance not for a queue-experiment session: either (a) restate MECH-349 as an ARCHITECTURAL/IMPLEMENTATION claim whose validation is the contract test suite plus a recorded parameter-sensitivity probe, and stop treating its zero claim_evidence count as a gap an experiment should close; or (b) re-scope it to a falsifiable consequence -- the honest candidate is that a minted field yields a DIFFERENTIATED rule_state that a shared-gradient scalar head cannot reach (the 598b inert-equilibrium contrast), which is a measurable prediction rather than a restatement. Until one of those happens, further validation attempts are predicted to fail the same way. Evidence: the four design-review reports and their verified measurements are summarised in chip chip-20260911-mech349-validation-redesign; the specific non-satisfiable criteria are GFLAG-0265 and GFLAG-0266.

items.summary: CORRECTION TO GFLAG-0265's REMEDY, plus the FALSIFYING(3) verdict it said was unreachable. GFLAG-0265 states 'Testing churn requires maintenance_floor below mature_retire_floor'. MEASURED 2026-09-11: that lever is INERT. _maybe_mint sets init_avail = max(tolerance_floor, maintenance_floor), so dropping maintenance_floor from 0.45 to 0.02 still mints at tolerance_floor 0.30 -- six times the 0.05 retire floor -- and crf_n_retired_total stays 0. Dropping tolerance_floor as well DOES retire (93 of 100 mints) but degenerately: every rule then mints BELOW the retire floor and dies on its first unprotected credit tick, MANUFACTURING the 666c signature rather than testing for it. The working lever is crf_maintenance_decay, the only knob in credit() that touches a rule carrying no eligibility and therefore the only one that can reach a rule that has gone silent. V3-EXQ-1025 (PASS/supports, ree-worker-3, manifest v3_exq_1025_mech349_crf_churn_retirement_20260911T181100Z_v3.json, script ree-v3 4de3eca) used it and settles FALSIFYING(3): churn is SELECTIVE, not a treadmill. Across 0.01-0.28 of the lever all 6 extinct-regime rules retire and ZERO still-recurring regimes lose or re-mint a slot, on 5/5 seeds; a single-axis positive control at 0.35 does produce the 666c treadmill (171 minted / 165 retired, 94 persistent re-mints), so the criterion was falsifiable and was not falsified. TWO FURTHER what_would_answer DEFECTS not in GFLAG-0265/0266, both measured: (a) non-degeneracy (b)'s 'crf_n_retired_total / crf_n_minted_total <= 0.25' is UNUSABLE in any ecology containing extinct regularities -- the ratio is then fixed by the ecology, and a perfectly SELECTIVE creator scores N_extinct/(N_persistent+N_extinct) = 0.50, FAILING the bar for behaving correctly; scoring must be per-regime-class. (b) non-degeneracy (c)'s first conjunct ('at least one mint in the final third') fails BY CONSTRUCTION in an all-regimes-from-tick-0 ecology -- all 12 mints landed in ticks 24-35 of 840 -- so it must be engineered for via staggered regime onsets, as V3-EXQ-1025 does, not assumed. ALSO: FALSIFYING(3) bundles three signatures that DISSOCIATE on the SD-078-centered key -- the positive control produces high-minted and comparable-retired in full while pairwise distance stays HIGH, because re-minted rules land back on the same well-separated regime directions; 666c's near-zero distance is a property of its UNCENTERED key, not an intrinsic consequence of churn. FINALLY, a metadata defect in the landed manifest: its related_exq names V3-EXQ-1024, an id reserved and released WITHOUT EVER BEING QUEUED (no run, no manifest); the script docstring was corrected in ree-v3 4de3eca but the manifest is immutable.

items.summary: MEASURED 2026-09-11: the SD-033a rule signal does NOT convert into committed action under V3-EXQ-598b's training regime, for EITHER a gradient-trained bias head OR the ARC-063 CandidateRuleField -- the MECH-439 F-dominance conversion ceiling, reproduced directly. Three arms were run on 598b's own instrument (its _encoder_step / _p1_train / _p2_reef_fraction imported unmodified), differing in exactly one factor each: ARM_0 bias head frozen + no CRF; ARM_1 bias head TRAINABLE + no CRF (598b's ARM_1); ARM_2 bias head frozen + CRF ON. The arms are demonstrably different internally -- ARM_1's mean |bias| reached 0.100000 (vs 598b's TRAINABLE_BIAS_MIN of 0.002) and ARM_2 minted a live 2-rule pool -- yet p2_reef_visit_fraction was BIT-IDENTICAL across all three arms at two independent budgets: 0.483 at (p0=3,p1=4,p2=2,steps=30) and 0.1034 at (p0=10,p1=20,p2=8,steps=60). Arm spread 0.0000 both times. A DV that does not move while the mechanism driving it moves by 0.1 is inert with respect to the manipulation, not merely under-powered. CONSEQUENCE: any behavioural arm contrast on this DV under this regime is unattributable, so V3-EXQ-1026 was BUILT AND DELIBERATELY NOT QUEUED -- it would consume cloud hours to return substrate_not_ready_requeue via its own dv_responds_to_arm precondition. This also CLOSES the last DV available to MECH-349. Taken with GFLAG-0265 (its distinctness criterion is an arithmetic identity off pinned_seed=6063 and its retirement criterion is structurally zero), GFLAG-0266 (clause (ii) is untestable on separated regimes; CONFIRMING(1)'s first half is a tautology of _maybe_mint) and the 2026-09-11 representational measurement (the legacy non-CRF rule_state EMA already scores margin 0.586 against V3-EXQ-598c's 0.15 floor, so minting has nothing to rescue there, while the CRF arm's higher 0.982 margin is dominated by the fixed geometry of 2 pinned directions and the pool does not grow with ecology richness -- 2 rules minted whether the ecology offers 2 contexts or 4), EVERY DV available to MECH-349 is now blocked for a separately-documented reason. FOR MECH-309 SPECIFICALLY: this run could not test its equilibrium claim either, because its reproduction leg (C1) requires the gradient arm to collapse and the DV cannot distinguish collapse from anything else here; 598b's original C3=False result stands unchallenged but also un-extended. FOR MECH-439: this is a direct, arm-controlled measurement of the conversion ceiling on the SD-033a rule path, which the ceiling's own record may not yet carry. Suggested disposition: adjudicate GFLAG-0268 (whether MECH-349 is empirically testable as written) BEFORE any further validation attempt is commissioned -- five independently-designed experiments have now been built for it and all five were stopped by a structural obstacle, each a different one.

items.summary: MECH-012's first literature pull (6 entries, targeted_review_mech_012, REE_assembly ad04a9a4a3; lit_conf 0.63, quadrant plausible_unproven, directions 2 supports / 2 mixed / 2 weakens) returned DIRECT DISCONFIRMING evidence for two of the claim's three written clauses, so the claim text -- not just its confidence -- needs a governance decision. (1) 'In collective systems language becomes the PRIMARY medium through which ethical residue is managed or displaced' fails for the diffusion limb: Beyer et al. 2017 (SCAN, PMID 27803288) found reduced sense of agency AND reduced feedback-related negativity from the MERE PRESENCE of another potential agent, with no utterance of any kind and with causation unambiguous -- co-presence alone suffices, so language cannot be primary there. Bandura, Underwood & Fromson 1975 supports the clause for the denial/absorption limbs (a linguistic characterisation of the target outweighed the responsibility structure), so the honest repair is to scope 'primary medium' to those limbs, or to restate it as 'language is what makes diffusion durable and transferable' rather than what causes it. (2) 'Ethical failure arises when symbolic language FULLY DECOUPLES from embodied harm signals and residue tracking' is contested by Haslam, Reicher, Millard & McDonald 2015 (Br J Soc Psychol, PMID 25196821): Milgram's participants were predominantly HAPPY to have taken part, which they attribute to identification with a goal framed as virtuous -- harm done with language tightly COUPLED to affect and merely re-signed. If that is right, REE's failure predicate is inverted: a detector watching for absent or attenuated residue would score the most dangerous institutional configuration as the healthiest, since the ideologically well-framed agent presents as untroubled and willing. Note this also puts Haslam 2015 in tension with Caspar et al. 2016 (PMID 26898470), the strongest supporting entry, which reads the same obedience phenomenon as agency-loss; governance should not read Caspar as settled. A third finding refines rather than contests: Ogunfowora et al. 2022 (JAP meta-analysis, PMID 34553966) reports that moral disengagement lowers moral awareness, moral judgment and ANTICIPATED guilt but RAISES guilt and shame POST-misconduct -- institutions sever residue's prospective gating pathway rather than deleting residue, which implies residue-write and residue-to-policy-gating must be separable components in any eventual substrate. MECH-012's experimental twin EXP-0743 remains blocked_substrate (9dde37e880); this flag concerns the claim's WORDING and is actionable now without substrate.
items.resolution_note: governance-20260924 user decision (A, rec-20260924-dd71591f): MECH-012 reworded in-cycle, claim kept whole (MECH-013 precedent). items.summary: MECH-003's architecture doc (docs/architecture/precision_scoping.md) states cross-tau precision projection is 'Directional (usually short -> long tau only)', but two independent, methodologically unrelated sources entered in the 2026-09-15 lit-pull point the other way: the hierarchical Gaussian filter (Mathys et al. 2011) has the HIGHER level set the LOWER level's step size, and Behrens et al. 2007 show a slowly-accumulated volatility estimate setting the learning rate applied to each next outcome -- both long -> short. The separation and explicit-projection-operator requirements of MECH-003 are well supported; only the unidirectionality gloss is contradicted, and it should either be corrected to bidirectional coupling or given an explicit REE-specific justification. Secondary discrepancy in the same doc: its non-normative biological note maps phasic dopamine to pi_gamma/pi_beta and tonic dopamine to pi_theta/pi_delta (one transmitter split by timescale), whereas Iglesias et al. 2013 (Neuron, replicated in two groups) find the low/high hierarchical split falling between dopamine (midbrain, low-level PE) and acetylcholine (basal forebrain, high-level PE). Evidence: REE_assembly c1160f28ff, evidence/literature/targeted_review_connectome_mech_003/.

MECH-003's separation and explicit-projection-operator requirements are unchanged.

items.summary: INV-095's pre-registered falsifier is UNROUTABLE as written and needs restating by governance. As stated ('replacing the harm signal with distribution-matched noise produces NO measurable degradation in E3 trajectory selection'), the falsifying state of the world is one in which the degradation statistic is UNDEFINED -- a decorative harm signal means the intact arm has no veridicality to decrement -- so no design can route that world to 'weakens'; it necessarily reads as instrument-not-ready instead. Confirmed by building the measurement: EVB-1368 (EXP-0720) was refused at /queue-experiment Step 4.5 on a red-team BLOCKING verdict and is now status blocked_substrate; TWO independent criterion formulations (absolute veridicality drop, and the scale-free retention ratio that replaced it) were BOTH structurally satisfied, because CausalGridWorldV2 re-draws hazard placement per episode so any substituted harm latent carries nothing about the current tick (max |rho_truth| over 20 state-uninformative cells = 0.1162). A restatement must name the SELECTION-level contrast against a TRAINED competing channel and say what instrument failure it is to be distinguished from. items.summary: V3-EXQ-1012b REFUSED at /queue-experiment Step 4.5 (red-team BLOCKING, verified by arithmetic against the landed V3-EXQ-1012a manifest). The routed design -- a PLACEBO differential-rescaling null built as a PERMUTATION of the operator's own fitted per-channel scales (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1012a_2026-09-14, user gate 2026-09-16T12:16:45Z) -- CANNOT DISCRIMINATE BY CONSTRUCTION on the scale geometry this lineage actually produces. MEASUREMENT (re-derived from v3_exq_1012a_..._20260914T221427Z_v3.json arm_results[*].channel_scale_estimates.scales; the driver was built, smoke-tested clean and its instrument cross-check measured EXACTLY 0.0 before this was found): exactly 3 channels are live in all 8 cells (benefit_weighted and goal_weighted are 0.0), so there are exactly 2 derangements. Writing the live scales a>=b>=c, the originally dominant channel D (residue_weighted in every fed cell, harm_weighted in every starved cell) retains dominance under BOTH derangements in 8 of 8 cells. Derangement giving D the smallest scale: D's normalised cross-candidate SD becomes a/c and D dominates MORE -- margins 4.8e4 to 3.9e5. Derangement giving D the middle scale: D stays dominant iff a*c > b^2, which holds in 8 of 8 cells -- margins 6.78 / 102.7 / 56.5 / 32.7 (fed) and 6.31 / 1.017 / 2.49 / 4.87 (starved). So the placebo argmin tracks the operator-OFF argmin, the placebo flip rate is ~0, and the pre-registered criterion |operator_flip - placebo_flip| >= 0.10 degenerates into 'the operator flips at all' -- exactly what V3-EXQ-1012a already established, and a PASS would have been routed to /governance as a reference-bearing read on rung 3 that it is not. STRUCTURAL REASON, which is the durable finding: with the live scales spanning four orders of magnitude, D's post-rescaling SD is a/sigma(D); under any BIJECTION onto {a,b,c} we have sigma(D) in {b,c} and both keep D on top, so the operator's OWN assignment is the UNIQUE permutation that equalises the channels. A permutation-style placebo is therefore structurally unavailable for this operator at this geometry, and the chip's own worked example is the construction the arithmetic refutes. WHAT IS OWED: a DIFFERENT discriminator for rung 3, not a bigger n and not another permutation -- /failure-autopsy or /governance to re-pose it. Until then the rung stays UNVALIDATED and the 936-family / 654h-class conversion-falsifier refusal in f_dominance_conversion_ceiling depends_on_unresolved[2] STANDS, unchanged. items.summary: V3-EXQ-1048 (MECH-268 ecological gradedness successor) REFUSED at /queue-experiment Step 4.5 -- red-team BLOCKING with 5 findings, the two decisive ones ARITHMETICALLY VERIFIED. No queue entry added, no script landed. FINDING 1, FATAL TO THE LOAD-BEARING CRITERION: the design's matched-density noise control cannot discriminate what it was built to discriminate, and its inequality points the WRONG WAY. dacc.py's _saturation_factor takes the fallback class (agent.py passes no current_outcome_class), so n_rec = 1 + Bin(window-1, p_class) under an IID control. At window 8 / grace 2 the 'interior' band (n_rec in 3..7, i.e. sat_factor strictly between the 0.25 floor and 1.0) therefore has probability 1 - P(0) - P(1) - P(7) = 119/128 = 0.9297 at p=0.5 (computed: 0.670/0.840/0.930/0.953/0.914 at p=0.3/0.4/0.5/0.6/0.7). The pre-registered criterion required ON_interior - NOISE_interior >= 0.10, which at p=0.5 needs ON >= 1.03 -- IMPOSSIBLE. Worse, the SIGN is backwards for the hypothesis: real ecological harm is POSITIVELY AUTOCORRELATED (hazard patches, the persistent harm_obs_a_ema), which pushes n_rec toward the window length and LOWERS interior relative to IID -- so an ON arm with genuine temporal structure would FAIL and be labelled 'density-explained'. THE DURABLE LESSON FOR ANY SUCCESSOR: an IID shuffle is not a neutral null for a RECURRENCE-COUNT statistic. Against a run-length-sensitive count, IID is the MAXIMUM-mixing extreme, not the middle; the contrast must be two-sided, or built on a statistic that is not monotone in mixing. FINDING 2, the control's density was never measured: the driver installed the noise wrapper and then installed V3-EXQ-729's record_outcome spy OUTSIDE it, so the spy recorded the LIVE class and not the injected Bernoulli one -- live_record_harm_fraction on the noise arm measured that agent's own harm rate, so the G2 'density match' compared two live streams and the injected density never reached any readout. G2b then sized the sample for a test that was not being performed. FIX IS ONE LINE (install the spy first, noise wrapper outside it) but it invalidates every G2/G2b number the smoke produced. FINDING 3: G1 gated on the SPREAD of harm_class_fraction across the ladder, which is green whenever the upper rungs read near ZERO -- and an all-no-harm FIFO pins n_rec just as chronically as the all-harm FIFO that degenerated V3-EXQ-729. A NOT-C1 result would then be emitted as an informative negative (evidence_direction weakens) against MECH-268 from a regime that is degenerate at the OTHER extreme. A successor must gate per-rung MIXEDNESS (harm_class_fraction inside an intermediate band), not spread. FINDING 4, MEASURED: the realised E3 tick period in the smoke is 9, not the assumed 8 (n_rec_series changes at indices 9/18/27/36), so 1800 eval steps yield ~200 live record_outcome calls against a G2b bar of 225 -- a scientifically valid run would have self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue on a count whose mean sits below its own bar, and the count is arousal-modulated (MECH-093 scales the E3 period 5-20) so the arms can legitimately differ in it. FINDING 5: x729._build_eval_env leaves _ENV_SEED_BASE at None, so every cell draws a fresh OS-entropy hazard layout; the ON/NOISE/OFF cells were therefore NOT paired on the ecology (only on the trained weights), which is precisely the quantity the contrast is about. WHAT IS WORTH KEEPING, all verified while building the refused driver: (a) V3-EXQ-729's own lever is INERT -- sweeping EVAL_HAZARDS over {2,4,6} left harm_class_fraction at 1.000 at EVERY rung, because z_harm_a.norm() sits at 0.55-0.70 while contextual_safety_harm_threshold ships at 0.05, an order of magnitude below the distribution it must split. That is the mechanical explanation of why V3-EXQ-729 saturated, which its autopsy could only describe. items.summary: ARC-083's title and functional_restatement assert, inheriting developmental_needs_register DEV-NEED-021, that 'otherness inference REQUIRES object persistence + a stable self' -- and the mirror_modelling_other_self_v5 plan turns that into per-node readiness_gates on PILLAR 1 permanence and PILLAR 2 self (ARC-081). A targeted developmental-psychology literature pull landed 2026-09-17 (REE_assembly 06fa0a6183, five entries in evidence/literature/targeted_review_arc_083/) finds that necessity claim is not supported and is contradicted three ways: (1) Kartner/Keller/Chaudhary 2010 Dev Psychol -- 19-month-olds in Delhi produced prosocial behaviour at the SAME rate as Berlin toddlers while the mirror-self-recognition link was absent, a matched-behaviour cross-cultural dissociation that a universal prerequisite forbids; (2) Sodian+Kristen-Antonow 2015 Dev Psychol -- in the only confound-controlled longitudinal design (n=83, 12->50mo, controlling gender and language), mirror self-recognition and level-1 visual perspective taking BOTH failed to mediate the path from 12-month declarative pointing to 50-month false belief, so the self-representational variable carried none of the predictive route; (3) Slaughter+Boh 2001 Infancy -- the only direct test of the object-permanence half REVERSES the stated ordering, with mother permanence outrunning object permanence in the same infants. The supporting side is one cross-sectional programme (Bischof-Kohler 2012) whose own proposed mechanism is synchronic identification -- holding self and other simultaneously -- which is a relational two-slot capacity rather than the self-stability ARC-081 supplies; Lucca et al. 2025 supports only by subtraction (a 37-lab, 567-infant failure to replicate Hamlin 2007 withdraws the strongest counterexample without adding positive evidence). TWO DISPOSITIONS ARE OWED AND BOTH ARE GOVERNANCE'S, NOT THE PULL'S: (a) whether ARC-083's inherited 'REQUIRES' wording should be weakened to a default build ORDERING, and whether its depends_on arrow belongs on ARC-081 at all or on ARC-080's slot-allocation machinery plus a triadic joint-attention primitive (which is where BOTH the supporting and the weakening sources independently point); (b) whether SD-039's motivational ghost bank -- which ARC-083's functional_restatement currently dismisses as 'not a true object-file persistence buffer' -- is in fact the RIGHT primitive for agent persistence, since the human evidence has motivationally-weighted person-permanence arriving FIRST; if so the permanence prerequisite could be met without waiting on PILLAR 1 to be registered and built. RAISED AS stale_note BECAUSE NOTHING ELSE WILL SURFACE THIS: ARC-083 and ARC-081 are architectural_commitment with promote/demote suppressed, so weakening literature accumulates against them without ever appearing in promotion_demotion_recommendations. Note also that the evidence index was NOT rebuilt when these entries landed (claim_evidence.v1.json and evidence/experiments/INDEX.md were already dirty from a concurrent session), so ARC-083 literature_confidence will read stale until the next governance regen.

items.summary: STEWARD D-006 (near-duplicate governance flags) produces FALSE POSITIVES on supersession chains, and the 2026-09-17 governance cycle hit one. D-006 groups flags by (claim_ids, flag_type, date) and reports any group of 2+ that are not byte-identical as needing human adjudication. But a flag and its own EXPLICIT SUCCESSOR raised the same day match that grouping exactly, and are not duplicates at all -- they are a correctly-recorded correction. WORKED INSTANCE: D-006 escalated '1 near-duplicate flag(s) of GFLAG-0307 need adjudication (MECH-017 / stale_note)'. Adjudicated 2026-09-17: GFLAG-0307 was ALREADY status=superseded, and GFLAG-0308's own summary ends 'Supersedes GFLAG-0307, whose summary predates the tick's status write and wrongly says the row is still status=proposed'. Nothing was owed on the pair as a pair; what WAS owed was GFLAG-0308's own action, which this cycle applied (executed_by/executed_queue_id on EVB-1390). SCOPE -- this is NOT a one-off: the same 2026-09-17 report carries SIX further D-006 groups in the identical shape (GFLAG-0046/ARC-045+4 claims, GFLAG-0106/MECH-163+2, GFLAG-0126/EXT-005, GFLAG-0151/MECH-025b, GFLAG-0216/SD-063, GFLAG-0266/MECH-349), each 'N near-duplicate flag(s) of GFLAG-xxxx', each at confidence 0.60, and each needing a human to re-derive a supersession relationship the registry may already record. SUGGESTED FIX for whoever owns the detector: before grouping, exclude any flag whose status is already 'superseded', and any pair where one flag's summary names the other as superseded -- both are cheap structural checks on data the registry already holds, and both would have suppressed this escalation without weakening the genuine duplicate case. METHOD CAVEAT, self-reported and relevant to reading the Steward report at all: this cycle ran governance.sh TWICE (the first run exited 1 at the Step 4b G2 gate). The first run reported ESCALATE=YES with this finding NEW; the second reported ESCALATE=no, because the steward ledger had recorded it in between and demoted it new -> recurring. A repeated governance.sh run therefore SILENCES its own escalations, and the second verdict is not independent of the first -- worth knowing before trusting an ESCALATE=no that follows a re-run.

Nothing in 0314 is retracted; the finding is unchanged and the detector defect stays open on 0328.

items.summary: A standing instrument contract blocks the only evidence SD-071 still needs, and the same contract blocks MECH-170. SD-071's what_would_answer states its REMAINING CONDITION FOR PROMOTION is 'one NON-DIAGNOSTIC run tagging this claim' -- both supporting runs (V3-EXQ-778c nrem null_slope_ratio 0.1445 CI95 [0.1438,0.1451]; V3-EXQ-778g sws 0.1495 CI95 [0.1344,0.1646] ceiling_inside_ci95 FALSE 8/8 seeds, C3 ladder 0.1108 vs the 0.01 floor) are experiment_purpose=diagnostic and so do not weight confidence. But the only instrument that can produce that evidence, the SD-068 consolidation lesion harness (ree-v3/experiments/_lib/consolidation_lesion_harness.py, 1843 lines, 89 importers), carries an unconditional contract at REE_assembly/docs/architecture/sd_068_consolidation_lesion_harness.md:548-558 (mirrored at consolidation_lesion_harness.py:143-147), headed 'Prerequisite caveat -- MECH-121 hold (respected, not lifted)': 'Any run built on it: MUST be EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE="diagnostic"; MUST NOT tag MECH-121 as promotion evidence or change its status'. As written, SD-071 can never be promoted. DECISION REQUESTED: whether a narrow carve-out is warranted -- non-diagnostic permitted when a run tags ONLY instrument-validity claims (SD-071) and tags neither MECH-120 nor MECH-121. The caveat's stated rationale is the MECH-121 hold and MECH-121 BEHAVIOURAL validation, whereas SD-071 asserts only that the readouts are content-contingent instruments, which is precisely the 'representation-level plumbing instrumentation' the caveat says the harness is; so the carve-out would honour the hold's purpose. MECH-170 is bundled because the same contract blocks it, and it has two further blockers of its own: the harness sweeps DAMAGE only (run_staged_sweep, harness:1777) with no staged-RESTORATION mode, while MECH-170 predicts a RECOVERY order; and its predicted recovery order (precision, then slot-filling, then slot-formation) is the same downstream-first order as the harness's already-banked staged-DECLINE order (harness:15, V3-EXQ-778a), so without a stated discriminator the criterion cannot distinguish the two. Substrate for SD-071 is otherwise fully built and verified read-only: nrem_transfer_fidelity harness:523 called :1039, _sws_pattern_completion harness:400 called :379. Full evidence in chip-proposal-exp-1206-paced and chip-proposal-exp-0905-paced prompts.

items.summary: CORRECTED REISSUE of GFLAG-0315, narrowed by a measurement taken after it was raised. UNCHANGED AND VERIFIED: the SD-070 world-encoder warmup is default-off -- zworld_p0_episodes defaults to 0 at five signature sites, and commit b523b9c's own message records OFF giving latent_stack 0/61, world_encoder 0/4, max_delta 0.0 with the guard REFUSING, against ON training world_encoder 4/4. Only 44 of 1503 experiment drivers mention the parameter, though mentioning is not enabling and the two were not separately counted. WHAT GFLAG-0315 OVERSTATED: it implied that z_world decodability evidence generally is measuring an untrained projection. The discriminating probe run on 2026-09-17 (ree-v3 cd60233+72befcc, REE_assembly evidence/planning/zworld_sense_path_parity_spike_20260916.md) measured an ENABLED regime and found all 4 world_encoder tensors move on every seed (max_abs_delta 0.23-0.39), so z_world is NOT frozen there. The scope is therefore drivers that do not enable the warmup, not the z_world evidence base as a whole. SEPARATE AND LARGER FINDING FROM THE SAME PROBE, which governance should treat on its own: V3-EXQ-1030's headline ~0.10 sense-vs-direct decodability gap DOES NOT REPRODUCE -- +0.007 and +0.019 paired over 50 cells against 1030's +0.1015, -0.018/+0.002 at 10x probe budget, -0.028/-0.023 standardised, against a null contrast resolving to +-0.004. The cause is a measurement defect, not substrate: 1030 compared feature sets differing 5x in magnitude using a fixed learning rate and fixed step budget, leaving the sense-path probe under-converged, and 1030's own manifest shows sense-path TRAIN accuracy below the direct path in all 10 cells. An encoder-free matched-width control shows a random Linear+ReLU costs about 0.00 of linear decodability, so neither candidate fix for SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY is a decodability repair. Recommended: demote that entry from degrading to hygiene and re-scope it to making the two paths agree; and require any V3-EXQ-1030a to standardise or verify probe convergence, use one split seed for both paths, and report train accuracy.

items.summary: MECH-019's what_would_answer CONFIRMING criterion requires a MONOTONIC graded redistribution of the operating_mode vector as a control-plane channel is swept, but the arousal literature it implicitly rests on reports an INVERTED-U: McGinley, David & McCormick (2015, Neuron 87:179-192, PMID 26074005) show cortical state and detection performance varying smoothly but non-monotonically with pupil-indexed arousal, peaking at intermediate levels. A substrate behaving exactly as MECH-019 describes could therefore produce a non-monotonic occupancy curve that the criterion as written would score as a failure to confirm. The property the claim actually needs is CONTINUITY (smooth occupancy as a function of the channel, with no flat-then-snap structure), not monotonicity; recommend rewording the criterion to test smoothness plus a comparison against a step-function fit. Separately, Latimer et al. (2015, Science 349:184-187, PMID 26160947) show that a trial-averaged graded trajectory is reproducible by jittered DISCRETE single-trial steps, so the criterion must also specify a PER-RUN readout -- as written, an averaged occupancy curve cannot separate MECH-019's CONFIRMING from its FALSIFYING outcome. Both points are documented with mappings in evidence/literature/targeted_review_mech_019 (REE_assembly origin/master 874be02c8e4). This is a falsifier-wording defect, not a challenge to the claim's status; it is worth fixing before MECH-019 is designed against, which matters now because sibling session igw-241 has just marked the MECH-019 experiment proposal (EVB-1392/EXP-0757) blocked_substrate with a release_condition that will eventually re-open exactly this test.

items.summary: GFLAG-0299's 'BANKED AND REUSABLE' working-lever finding is CONTESTED BY MEASUREMENT and should not be carried forward by further pre-flights as authoritative. GFLAG-0299 banked: 'THE WORKING LEVER is contextual_safety_harm_threshold. Smoke sweep over {0.05,0.55,0.75} moved harm_class_fraction 1.000/0.625/0.450 (spread 0.45)', and the 2026-09-17 AMBER pre-flight forwarded it under 'do not rediscover'. Re-measured 2026-09-17 by science-20260917-mech268-gradedness on a TRAINED agent (P0 20x100 converged, seed 42, shared state_dict snapshot, 500 eval steps/threshold, strength 0.3, harm fraction read off a spy on dacc.record_outcome i.e. the stream that actually drives n_rec): the FULL sweep 0.05/0.35/0.50/0.60/0.65/0.70/0.80 moves harm_class_fraction only 1.000/0.982/0.964/0.964/0.964/0.946/0.946 -- total movement 0.054, never approaching 0.5. The banked 0.45 spread was almost certainly taken on an untrained agent; an untrained replication gives 1.000/0.956/0.240/0.900/0.000, large but NON-MONOTONE and erratic, because the threshold sits inside a closed loop (harm class -> record_outcome -> n_rec -> sat_factor -> PE -> control_required -> selection). It is not a clean exogenous dose at any training level. CONSEQUENCE: the user-ratified 2026-09-17 design's pinning step and its harm_class_fraction in [0.3,0.7] gate are not executable; running it as specified guarantees non_degenerate:false. SEPARATE POSITIVE FINDING, same measurement: gradedness IS richly exercised in the live loop regardless (n_rec spans 0..8, interior occupancy 0.911-0.946 at EVERY threshold) because ClosureOperator._fire() calls dacc.reset_outcome_history() (closure_operator.py:727-730, default on), clearing the saturation FIFO on rule completion -- so the ecological driver of graded dACC saturation is CLOSURE CADENCE, not harm-density mixedness. That also explains V3-EXQ-729's sat=0.25 in all 6x2 cells without appealing to harm chronicity (729's cells were not firing closure). Also confirmed: realised E3 tick period 8.57-8.93, and the dACC _last_* diagnostics LATCH between E3 ticks, so 729's per-env-step read is ~8.6x pseudo-replicated. Full record committed+pushed: REE_assembly e64d57908f evidence/planning/mech268_gradedness_lever_remeasurement_staged_20260917.md. Blocked pending user answer on decision chip chip-20260917-mech268-gradedness-nondegeneracy-gate-decision. MECH-268 status untouched.

All THREE PM groups this flag measured (GFLAG-0315/0320, 0316/0317, 0325/0326) are suppressed.

ONE DEPARTURE FROM THE SPECIFIED PREDICATE, and it is the reason the negative control survives. This flag specifies two clauses -- one member dispositioned, another member's summary CONTAINS its flag_id -- and that test as literally stated also suppresses GFLAG-0307/0308, which this flag names as the case that must keep escalating. Measured on the live registry: nothing else separates them. GFLAG-0307 is status=superseded, carries a resolution_note naming 0308, and 0308's summary names 0307 -- structurally identical to the three PM groups. The only discriminator is the OFFSET of the reference: every true chain declares itself in its opening clause (GFLAG-0047 at 11, 0109 at 12, 0127 at 11, 0320 at 21, 0317 at 21, 0326 at 13) whereas GFLAG-0308 makes a DIFFERENT finding (EXP-0753's provenance fields unset, where 0307 said the row still read proposed) and cites its predecessor in passing at offset 981 of 1090. Clause (b) is therefore implemented as a leading-160-character window plus a supersession-vocabulary token: fitted to a 21-vs-981 gap, not to a point.

PARTIAL ON THE SIX GROUPS GFLAG-0314 ENUMERATED -- 3 of 6 suppressed, and the other 3 are NOT supersession chains. GFLAG-0046/0047, 0106/0109 and 0126/0127 are chains and are suppressed. GFLAG-0151/0152 and GFLAG-0216/0217 are two DISTINCT thought-digestion items sharing a claim, a type and a staging date; neither summary names the other. GFLAG-0270 opens 'CORRECTION TO GFLAG-0265's REMEDY' -- it supersedes GFLAG-0265, whose claim_ids are [MECH-349, MECH-350] and which therefore lands in a DIFFERENT group; 0266 and 0270 are genuinely distinct findings and 0266 is still open. 0314's 'identical shape' reading was a guess about six groups it had not opened, and measurement refutes it for three of them.

TWO WIDER PREDICATES TRIED AND REJECTED, both pinned as negative controls in test_autofix.py, because each also swallows GFLAG-0307/0308: (1) 'suppress when every member is dispositioned' -- 0307 superseded + 0308 resolved; (2) 'allow the cross-reference to live in the resolution_note' -- 0307's note names 0308. That trade is a governance call and was deliberately NOT taken unilaterally; see the README section 'Do not widen D-006's supersession-chain suppression'.

RESIDUAL, stated rather than papered over: GFLAG-0307/0308 still escalates as a near-duplicate every time it reads as NEW, and GFLAG-0314's own adjudication says 'nothing was owed on the pair as a pair'. If governance decides that finding has no value either, the right home is a state/suppressions.yaml entry (a recorded disposition), not a wider detector predicate -- and this flag's negative control should be retired explicitly first.
