items.summary: V3-EXQ-1051 (MECH-268 live-loop gradedness) REFUSED at /queue-experiment Step 4.5 -- red-team BLOCKING, three decisive findings re-verified against source by the authoring session. NO queue entry added, NO script landed, ree-v3 untouched, MECH-268 status unchanged (provisional). This is the FIRST refusal on this item that is about the DESIGN rather than a stale premise: the two user decisions behind it (chip-20260917-mech268-gradedness-dose-variable-decision -> gain ladder; chip-20260917-mech268-gradedness-nondegeneracy-gate-decision -> gate on interior occupancy) were sound on what was known, but the resulting criteria are arithmetic consequences of the design's own non-degeneracy gate. F1 FATAL: sat_factor = 1/(1+strength*excess) with excess bounded [0,6] at window 8/grace 2, and every rung of a seed shares one trained snapshot and one pinned eval env, so the adjacent-rung gap is minimised at excess=1 -- per-observation minima 0.1304/0.1003/0.1026 for the pairs 0->0.15/0.15->0.3/0.3->0.5. A gate of interior_occupancy >= 0.5 therefore GUARANTEES every gap >= 0.0502 while C1 requires only >= 0.03, so C1's failure region lies strictly inside the region the gate already declares red -- the gate excludes exactly the runs on which C1 could discriminate. C3 likewise: (1-sat(s)) is strictly increasing in s for every excess>=1 and pe>=0, and R(S000)=0 exactly because strength=0 gives sat==1.0 bit-identically, so the 1e-9 tolerance is compared against an exact zero. C2 is pinned at exactly 0.0 because _apply_arm writes the knobs directly onto the same DACCConfig object _saturation_factor reads, which ALSO means C2 does not catch the c7fc045 propagation gap it was written for. Net: the run's only empirical content (is the live recurrence stream non-degenerate?) sits in the GATE while the CRITERIA carry its arithmetic consequences, and the pre-registered null -- a step function on {floor,1.0} with no gain-dependence -- is not a state the substrate can occupy, since dacc.py:249-252 has no binary branch at all. F5 FATAL and an authoring bug: the interior gate counts 0.0<s<1.0, but the floor at strength 0.5 IS 0.25 -- exactly V3-EXQ-729's pinned value -- so a constant-at-floor series scores interior_occupancy 1.000 and PASSES the gate written to catch that degeneracy (verified: [0.25]*270 -> 1.000). The gate has one working leg (n_rec_distinct>=4), not two. F2 CONTESTED and verified: dacc_weight defaults to 0.0 (config.py:3725) and DACCtoE3Adapter.forward's own docstring says the bias is the zero vector under default config (dacc.py:523-527), so the saturated PE has provably ZERO reach into E3 selection here; and pe_post was computed by the driver as pe_unsat*sat_factor rather than read from the substrate's published bundle['pe'] (dacc.py:227/450), making 'the graded factor reaches the PE readout' true by construction. F3 CONTESTED and verified: evidence_direction is set unconditionally to weakens on any FAIL, so a red gate or a C2 wiring regression would both record weakens against MECH-268, contradicting the script's own interpretation grid; the degeneracy net does not rescue it (interior floor 0.01 vs gate 0.5). SALVAGEABLE AND VERIFIED WORKING for a successor: the E3 latch fix (realised period measured 8.57-8.93; clear-before-call plus n_latched_ticks; smoke 25 fresh / 195 latched of 220), pinned per-seed eval env (GFLAG-0299 Finding 5), shared-snapshot training reuse, the spy installed before the eval loop (GFLAG-0299 Finding 2), and the applies_to scoping of the interior precondition off the zero-gain rung. WHAT IS OWED: a decision on what a live-loop gradedness test can falsify at all, given f_sat's functional form is fixed in source. Candidates, none ratified: (1) make the live n_rec DISTRIBUTION the measurement rather than the gate; (2) test the registered DOWNSTREAM property with dacc_weight > 0, since with dacc_weight=0 nothing is actually adapted; (3) closure cadence as the ecological dose (chip-20260917-mech268-closure-cadence-dose). Full record: REE_assembly c830c8cc66 evidence/planning/mech268_gradedness_v3_exq_1051_redteam_refusal_20260917.md. Red-team ran on Opus (the Fable override was rejected on a spend limit; re-spawned on the session model per Step 4.5).

items.summary: SD-091's substrate_queue.json implementation_hint JUSTIFIES THE BUILD WITH TWO STATISTICS THE USER WITHDREW AT THE GATE. The hint leads with 'commensurability equalises magnitude (783.81 -> 4.67) but does NOT decouple rank (|rho| 0.9910 -> 0.9643 against a 0.4 bar)'. But failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1038a_2026-09-17.md line 96 records: 'User decision at the gate: keep the elimination with met_elimination_bar: true on a basis rewritten onto NON-CIRCULAR STATISTICS ONLY (residual spread 5.48x, CV 0.449, and the post-hoc), with an explicit circularity caveat recorded on the leg. F2's 0.964, G3b's 0.991, and F2's non-degeneracy certificate (which is gated on G3b) are NOT relied upon.' The autopsy's section on near-circularity (line 24) explains why: eligibility_fraction is the empirical CDF at 0.05 of a cell's margin samples and is regressed against the MEDIAN of those same samples, so Spearman between a median and a CDF-at-a-fixed-point is monotone by construction unless cell shapes cross; G3b's 0.991 is 'close to an arithmetic identity, not evidence the OFF arm is scale-determined'. Worse, the hint's framing is BACKWARDS on the non-circular form: line 28 records that regressing the OFF-arm median (intrinsic scale, before the operator) against ON eligibility gives |rho| = 0.321, which PASSES the 0.4 bar. THE BUILD ITSELF IS NOT AFFECTED AND SHOULD PROCEED -- it is correctly motivated by the post-hoc table (fixed 0.05 as shipped: CV 0.4488, spread 5.483), which line 41 calls 'the load-bearing evidence for the routing -- a non-circular, zero-compute existence proof that the residual IS scale and that a scale-relative threshold is the repair'. A build session (substrate-build-20260917-triad) independently caught this discrepancy and re-derived the buildability check from the banked V3-EXQ-1038a samples rather than from the disowned statistics: it showed pooled_median is one constant shared by every cell so the post-hoc threshold is algebraically (0.05/pooled_median) * cell_median -- a per-stream statistic times a fixed calibration constant -- and replaying the banked ON-arm samples through a running single-stream window median reproduces the collapse at every window from 25 to 500 (W=200/warmup=100: CV 0.105, spread 1.347 against target CV ~0.124 / spread ~1.45). ASK: rewrite the implementation_hint onto the non-circular basis the gate decision already mandates, so the next reader is not re-justified by withdrawn numbers. This is the SECOND finding of this class on this file today -- see GFLAG-0331 for five stale-bookkeeping entries out of 14 build_owed rows.

(1) INV-022: conditional_predictive_variance is a select() kwarg read at e3_selector.py:3845, but REEAgent.select_action never includes it in its kwargs dict -- its only non-test occurrence outside that file is a DOCSTRING EXAMPLE at e2_world_uncertainty.py:193 -- so use_conditional_precision_gate=True always falls through to the state-blind _running_variance and ARM A IS BIT-IDENTICAL TO ARM B. Compounding: precision_weighted appears ZERO times in ree_core, so the precondition's named instrument does not exist; and use_e2_world_uncertainty alone only instantiates the head (training needs the separately default-False use_e2_world_uncertainty_online_training, which the claim never names). claims.yaml's 'small driver-side build' for the environment is wrong -- causal_grid_world.py has no observation-noise knob of any kind (zero grep hits) and no switching schedule. INV-022 has no claim_evidence entry at all. (2) MECH-028: operating_mode is assigned at salience_coordinator.py:491 BEFORE the threshold logic, and write_gate() iterates self._operating_mode at :562 -- _current_mode never feeds back, so NO VALUE of switch_threshold can perturb any MECH-261 gate even with every consumer armed; a 2026-09-18 measurement re-ran the lock with correct mode names and got nine telemetry channels moving by exactly 0.0 with zero action changes. Its CONFIRMING clause needs (C)>(A) AND (B)!=(A); the second conjunct is ~0 by proof, so the design can only return FALSIFYING, and that text would assert 'mode transitions are irrelevant to harm behaviour in V3', which is false. Prerequisite already owned by open chip chip-20260917-sd032a-operating-mode-no-consumer. NOTE the chip header's 2026-09-16 RED reason ('no what_would_answer') is now STALE -- the falsifier exists and is dated 2026-09-16; the claim is RED for the substrate reason instead. (3) MECH-034: 'M does not raise residue' is ANALYTIC, not a finding -- residue_field.accumulate is called only under 'if harm_signal < 0' (agent.py:10908-10914) plus one harm-gated E3 site, so the readout is an identity; the surprise-valence writes go to a separate vector evaluate() does not read. StalenessAccumulator is keyed (scale, segment_id) -- an event-segment index, not a place -- with pe_dict=None at its sole call site (agent.py:5551) and default 1/N uniform credit, so it is spatially blind. Environment crux: causal_grid_world.py:969-973 raises unless world_rule_shift_scope is 'action_map', so M CANNOT be region-localised at all. Already adjudicated elsewhere: EXP-0772 is blocked_substrate with a release condition naming these gaps, and GFLAG-0339 contests the 2026-09-16 'testable now' disposition with cross-region spread measured at 0.0. Route is /implement-substrate. (4) INV-063 -- THE ONE WORTH ACTING ON, because all three of its blockers are claim-TEXT problems needing NO code build. Its P1 requires MEL while its P2 pins use_mel_consumer=False, and self.mel_consumer is None unless that flag is true (agent.py:2890-2894), so P2's pinning makes P1's own gate UNMEASURABLE -- mutually exclusive as written. Separately P1's monotone-MEL gate ENTAILS its surprise_weight sub-DV arithmetically (the MECH-268 shape): surprise_weight = min(1.0, _pe_ema * 5.0) at agent.py:10686 and MEL both read the SAME scalar e3_metrics['prediction_error'] (agent.py:10781 and :10847), and _pe_ema ~1.3e-3 is nowhere near the min saturation. And what_would_answer names leg B as 'E1 world-model updating', whose route still passes through ContextMemory (substrate_queue contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy, still implemented_pending_validation / ready:false) -- a defect aligned with the IV. PROPOSED AMENDMENT, all text: (a) re-specify leg B onto the E2 world-forward heads, which sidestep ContextMemory entirely (e2_fast.py contains no ContextMemory reference; _world_experience_buffer is fed from latent_state.z_world) and whose sleep-time gradient path NOW EXISTS as of ree-v3 4610133 landed today -- this also makes EXP-1398's banked 2026-09-08 'no sleep->E2 gradient' gating PARTLY STALE and it should not be carried forward unre-verified; (b) demote surprise_weight from a scored sub-DV to a manipulation-check readout; (c) resolve the P1/P2 contradiction by defining MEL driver-side as a mean over e3_metrics['prediction_error'] rather than via the consumer flag. With those three text changes INV-063 becomes the cheapest dispatchable science item available.

items.summary: ARC-094's WORDING denotes a different architecture from the one intended, and the mismatch changes how its evidence reads -- a terminological reconciliation for governance, not a note. The claim says fast empathy must emerge from 'binding existing motivational-affective streams across self -> object -> other', which reads as CONCURRENT COMPOSITION (other-directed affect computed by routing through the self's own affective code). On that reading Krishnan et al. 2016 (eLife 5:e15166, registered 2026-09-18 under targeted_review_connectome_arc_094) falsifies it for pain: somatic and vicarious pain multivariate patterns each classify intensity at 100% within-condition and cross-predict at CHANCE, so the self-pain code carries no information about the other's pain. The user confirmed on 2026-09-18 that the INTENDED reading is developmental BOOTSTRAPPING -- the fast affective route scaffolds the slower mentalizing route, which then differentiates -- under which the same result is the PREDICTED mature endpoint rather than a refutation, because differentiation from a shared origin is exactly what a scaffold produces. Requested disposition: reword ARC-094 from concurrent binding to temporal scaffolding. MECH-569 (registered 2026-09-18, REE_assembly 85068e0d444) already states the scaffolding relation explicitly and is co-flagged so the pair is reviewed together; if ARC-094 is reworded, check whether MECH-569 is then partly redundant with it or remains the separate empirical assertion it is currently written as. ADJACENT, NOT FLAGGED HERE: MECH-405 carries the same runtime-flavoured 'routing ... through a stable other-model slot' language, and MECH-570 (also new) challenges the self-stage starting condition both ARC-094 and MECH-405 presuppose -- governance may wish to consider all four together. Evidence basis: Meltzoff 2007 Dev Sci 10:126-134 ('the starting point for social cognition, not its culmination'); Lamm/Decety/Singer 2011 NeuroImage 54:2492-2502 (route-dependence -- picture cues recruit somatosensory/action areas, abstract cues recruit mentalizing, so BOTH routes persist in the adult). SCOPE LIMIT, stated so this is not over-read: the corpus does not test the bootstrapping claim directly -- laboratory vicarious-pain paradigms use images and video with processing time and plausibly probe the slow cognitive route only, so the fast route is largely unmeasured. This flag asks for a wording reconciliation, NOT a promotion; ARC-094 remains candidate/v5/v3_pending and nothing here licenses a build.

items.summary: THIRTEEN CONSECUTIVE EXPERIMENT REFUSALS, and the last three CONVERGE ON ONE ORGAN -- the residue field. This flag carries the corpus finding, one hard substrate defect, and a cheap curation check that would have caught two of three in a minute without a run. (1) MECH-105 IS A SUBSTRATE DEFECT, NOT A DESIGN PROBLEM: compute_completion_signal = sigmoid(-best_score*0.5) (hippocampal/module.py:3260), so clearing the 0.75 completion-release threshold requires best_score <= -2.197; but best_score = rbf_field + 0.1*neural_field summed over the horizon (residue/field.py:628-631), RBF weights initialise to ZERO and accumulate POSITIVE harm magnitude through a NON-NEGATIVE kernel, and all three subtractive terms default to zero (wanting_weight config.py:2585, curiosity_weight config.py:2606, mode_conditioning_enabled config.py:2635). ACHIEVABLE RANGE IS (0, 0.5]. THE 0.75 THRESHOLD IS UNREACHABLE AS AN IDENTITY, so the specified ON/OFF ablation yields bit-identical arms. The module's own docstring at :3241-3243 claims the range is '[0.5, 1.0)' and is INVERTED. Three further blockers sit on top: heartbeat.beta_gate_bistable defaults False (config.py:3311) so agent.py:6254 never runs at prod config AND from_dims silently swallows the kwarg; and completion_release_threshold is not a config field anywhere -- agent.py:497-510 constructs BetaGate without it, pinning the ctor default 0.75 reachable only by poking a private attribute. THIS NEEDS A substrate_queue ENTRY, not fleet compute. (2) CORRECTION TO A BANKED FIGURE THIS ORCHESTRATOR SUPPLIED: I passed forward V3-EXQ-944's 'completion trigger fired 0 of 15 cells'. The pre-flight refused to bank it and was right -- it appears in NO archived manifest (zero 'completion' hits across all three 944 packs; the diagnostics assembled at v3_exq_944*.py:539-546 were never persisted), and the two recorded maxima CONFLICT: 0.20-0.39 in a pre-queue probe docstring vs 0.0 in the real 15-cell run. A max of exactly 0.0 means receive_hippocampal_completion was never invoked at all -- a DIFFERENT failure from 'signal too low'. Treat 944's figure as UNVERIFIED; the arithmetic bound in (1) is independent and stronger. (3) CORRECTION TO THE QUEUE RECORD: V3-EXQ-1051 was NEVER QUEUED -- 1050 and 1052-1055 have scripts, 1051 is a gap -- and IGW-20260917-242's MECH-023 session closed with a REFUSAL, not a queue (REE_assembly 055b4d35553, GFLAG-0337). MECH-023 has exp=0 in claim_evidence.v1.json. Anyone told 'MECH-023 is being queued as V3-EXQ-1051', including by me, should disregard it. (4) THE CONVERGENCE, which is the actual finding: MECH-024's ethics lesion and MECH-023's whole design both die on RESIDUE-FIELD GEOMETRY -- RBFLayer.add_residue is a 32-SLOT RING BUFFER while harm fires on 62.5% of steps, so 895 harm events into 32 slots is 28 wraps in 720 steps and a divergent harm history RELOCATES trained centres rather than adding to them; and kernel_bandwidth=1.0 against a visited z_world manifold whose MAX pairwise distance is 0.1249 leaves the field spatially near-uniform (the two most distant reachable points read 0.9922 apart). MECH-105's completion signal is a sigmoid OF residue cost, so its unreachable threshold is a scaling bug on the SAME quantity. A fourth defect in the same organ is already chipped independently: chip-20260917-residue-integrate-no-gradient-step (ResidueField.integrate never calls backward()). There is NO substrate_queue entry for residue-field GEOMETRY -- SD-024, ARC-046, SD-RESIDUE-VALENCE-BOUND and SD-067 are all other residue items. PROPOSED: open one, and treat it as the next unit of effort ahead of a fourteenth experiment design. (5) THE GENERATOR, worth acting on: these claims' what_would_answer blocks were RECENTLY HARDENED -- detailed non-degeneracy preconditions written from earlier refusals -- but hardened as constraints on the EXPERIMENT, while the actual blockers are properties of the SUBSTRATE that no design can satisfy. So the hardening is making designs more elaborate without making them runnable. PROPOSED CHEAP CHECK, to run at claim-curation time rather than after a worker is dispatched: DOES THE DV'S PRODUCER HAVE AN ACHIEVABLE RANGE THAT CROSSES ITS CONSUMER'S THRESHOLD? MECH-105 falls to that on arithmetic alone in about a minute with no run, and two of today's three would have been caught by it. This is the same family as the integration-deficit check already chipped as chip-20260917-integration-deficit-skill-check, but cheaper and earlier -- consider folding it in there rather than as a separate gate.

items.summary: STEP 0a ITEM 1 HAS A DEFECT ON RETIRED MACHINES: declaring a usage pause MASKS a permanent RETIRED disposition and silently disarms a safety guard. Measured, not argued, 2026-09-18. metaworker-orchestrate SKILL.md Step 0a (landed today, REE_Working 99c7740e8) instructs, at the >=95% weekly band: 'Declare the pause in scripts/dispatcher_pauses.json with clear_at = the resetsAt you just read'. I did exactly that for ree-cloud-5 (commit 7e2673a75e) and check_metaworker_timer_state.py flipped that machine from RETIRED to PAUSED-DECLARED. That is a REGRESSION, because the two states are not interchangeable: a retired entry INVERTS the usual polarity for that machine -- a STOPPED retired timer reports RETIRED and is not a fault, while an ARMED one reports RETIRED-BUT-ARMED and IS a fault, per the 2026-08-25 user instruction that a retired timer must 'not ever be woken up unless I specifically wake it up myself'. A non-retired pause entry shadows that inversion, so while the pause is live a re-armed ree-metaworker.timer may no longer be flagged. I reverted (commit 735a36ab5b, both boxes verified back to RETIRED on re-run) and am recording the usage-pause provenance here instead. WHY THE INSTRUCTION READS AS IT DOES, and why it is nonetheless a no-op for its stated purpose on this fleet: dispatcher_pauses.json exists to stop a STOPPED resident ree-metaworker.timer reading as STOPPED-UNDECLARED. But BOTH cloud boxes have carried retired:true entries since 2026-08-23/25 -- the resident dispatch timers were retired in favour of lease-gated dispatch -- so the checker ALREADY reports 'not a finding and needs no renewal' for them with or without a pause entry. Step 0a's stated rationale also cites dispatch_usage_cooldown.py as consuming 'the same machinery'; it does not -- grep shows the only readers of dispatcher_pauses.json are check_metaworker_timer_state.py and its tests, while dispatcher_control.py merely mentions the filename in a comment. So on the current fleet item 1 buys nothing for its stated purpose and costs a real safety property. PROPOSED AMENDMENT: gate item 1 on the machine NOT already carrying retired:true -- i.e. 'declare the pause only for a machine whose resident timer is live and would otherwise read STOPPED-UNDECLARED; for a RETIRED machine, record the usage-pause provenance in the governance flag / WORKSPACE_STATE instead, because a non-retired entry masks the retirement'. Alternatively teach check_metaworker_timer_state.py to let retired:true WIN over an overlapping pause, which is the more robust fix since it removes the footgun rather than documenting it. THE REST OF STEP 0a IS SOUND AND I FOLLOWED IT: the >=95% band, withholding the grant rather than issuing a stop (silence stops the Dispatcher by design, and a stop call would spend tokens precisely when there are none), the curation gate covering Step 1b/1d as well as the lease, and the scope caveat that get_usage reports only the Mac session's account. Live reading that triggered this: weekly all-models 97%, Weekly-Fable 100%, extra usage DISABLED at EUR 45.89 against a EUR 40.00 cap, reset 2026-09-22T03:00:00Z. Action taken: the ree-cloud-5 lease (orchestrate-20260918-gc, to 2026-09-18T15:18:08Z) was NOT renewed and left to expire so the in-flight ARC-029 science worker could finish; no new bundles curated; no new science subagents launched.

items.summary: SD-011's what_would_answer misstates the regime of its OWN four validated results, and applying its own clause (i) makes two of them vacuous. Clause (i) says a run with harm_history_len=0 is VACUOUS as an SD-011 test 'regardless of what its stream_corr reads'; the preamble then asserts the four validated results (EXQ-178b, EXQ-198, EXQ-323a, the D3-reversal resolution) were ALL obtained at harm_history_len=10. Measured this session against ree-v3 e1ff0927: v3_exq_178b(:158), v3_exq_198(:196) and v3_exq_323a(:326) all construct AffectiveHarmEncoder(harm_obs_a_dim=..., z_harm_a_dim=...) with NO harm_history_len argument, so all three take the default 0 (ree_core/latent/stack.py:208-209). Only v3_exq_472 sets 10, and it is scoring_excluded: diagnostic_probe. The rank-2 measurement (GFLAG-0348) explains why clause (i) was right: at harm_history_len=0 the encoder's only input is harm_obs_a, which on the default path carries two scalars broadcast over 25 dims each (causal_grid_world.py:3037-3038), so z_harm_a cannot be anything but a transform of the sensory stream. SECOND stale note, same lineage: SD-022's functional_restatement describes the legacy harm_obs_a as 'structurally identical to harm_obs with a slower time constant' -- that describes the PRE-2026-03-28 construction; ree-v3 2fbf5d62 (2026-03-28) replaced the 50-dim spatial EMA with the two-scalar broadcast, so the legacy path is now strictly poorer than that sentence says. items.summary: SD-071's second pre-registered falsifier (the sws content-scale ladder vs the 0.01 floor) CANNOT discharge the caveat the claim says it discharges -- verified bit-exactly, surfaced by the Step 4.5 red-team on V3-EXQ-1058 (model fable, verdict CONTESTED). MECHANISM: in the SD-068 harness, damage is referenced to the UNSCALED content (diffuse_perturb rms_ref=...), so it is held numerically fixed while content is scaled by content_scale=cs; under the rebuilt sws readout's SCALE-INVARIANT cosine, scaling content by cs at damage d is arithmetically identical to scaling damage by 1/cs at full content. Hence error(content_scale=cs, sigma=s) == error(content_scale=1.0, sigma=s/cs). CONFIRMED against V3-EXQ-778g's own recorded ladder_error_series on its doubling sigma grid [0.0,0.25,0.5,1.0,2.0]: rung0.5[i] == rung1.0[i+1] and rung0.25[i] == rung1.0[i+2] for every i>=1, EXACT on 8/8 seeds (the sigma=0 point is 0 in every rung by construction). CONSEQUENCE: the "content-scale ladder" is a SIGMA-REPARAMETERISATION of the injected arm's own damage curve, so what C3 actually tests is that that curve is GRADED rather than step-shaped. That is real and failable (a saturating curve gives spread ~0 and C3 fails), so C3 is NOT vacuous and V3-EXQ-1058 still answers its own question -- but C3 does NOT independently establish that the sws readout tracks content AMOUNT, which is exactly how SD-071's what_would_answer ("the scale-invariance caveat that C3 was pre-registered to discharge") and the V3-EXQ-778g docstring both present it. SAME ROOT CAUSE, recorded alongside: the sws NULL-arm error series is {0, c, c, c, c} (n_distinct 2 on 8/8 seeds in 778g) -- flat above sigma=0 because the cosine annihilates the sigma factor on a pure-noise store -- so the sws null SLOPE is driven entirely by the sigma=0 discontinuity and a low sws null_slope_ratio is partly implied by the readout's form. The harness's own NULL_MIN_NULL_SERIES_DISTINCT = 2 is what lets that series count as non-degenerate. SECOND, SEPARABLE ITEM: the nrem leg's DV is the output of ree_core/sleep/cross_module_consolidation.py CrossModuleConsolidator -- whose module header names it the MECH-121 consolidation cluster -- stepping with torch.optim.Adam (:162) and skipping exactly-zero-loss modules (:173-177). Adam's per-parameter step normalisation is non-linear, and a LINEAR consolidator would make the nrem injected and null series differ by a sigma-independent constant, i.e. ratio 1.0 by arithmetic -- the same affine cancellation that retired the old sws SNR readout. So the nrem leg's content-contingency is not wholly independent of that operator's update rule, which means the 2026-09-18 carve-out's RATIONALE sentence ("cannot bear on MECH-121 even incidentally") is stronger than the source supports for that leg. This does NOT breach the carve-out: its two CONDITIONS are about TAGGING, and V3-EXQ-1058 tags exactly [SD-071], tags neither MECH-120 nor MECH-121, and cannot move MECH-121's status under any outcome. GOVERNANCE ACTION REQUESTED: (a) when V3-EXQ-1058 reports, weight an SD-071 PASS knowing what C3 does and does not establish, and decide whether SD-071's what_would_answer should be amended to stop crediting C3 with discharging the scale-invariance caveat; (b) decide whether an INDEPENDENT anti-scale-invariance check is owed for the sws leg (that would be a NEW instrument, hence /implement-substrate, not another lettered iteration); (c) note the carve-out rationale sentence has been narrowed to what is defensible, CONDITIONS UNCHANGED. NOT ACTED ON BY THE QUEUEING SESSION: C1 and C3 are transcribed verbatim from SD-071's own falsifier, and re-scoping either would change what the run measures, which is a governance call and not a queue session's. Full detail is in the V3-EXQ-1058 driver docstring and its manifest interpretation block (key c3_ladder_is_a_sigma_reparameterisation).

items.summary: MECH-018 readout (iii) COMPRESSION needs an explicit governance decision: NARROW it to the 'lower integration_loss at fewer parameters' disjunct the claim already offers, or commission a centre-merge op. EXP-0755's release_condition part (3) offers exactly that either/or; parts (1) and (2) landed 2026-09-19 (ree-v3 8997e243: ResidueField.integrate() now performs a real Adam/backward step over neural_field only, plus a flag-gated call site in SleepLoopManager._run_cycle's WRITEBACK phase). Measured across 5 seeds after the build, active_centers is 6 -> 6 -- integrate() approximates the RBF field, it never merges centres, and no module in ree_core/ provides a merge op -- so (iii) as written stays structurally unreachable and any MECH-018 run would still return a FALSE partial falsification on that readout alone. This build session did NOT edit claims.yaml (governance-only per CLAUDE.md High-Contention Files) and did NOT invent a merge semantics (a new mechanism, not an unblock). RECOMMENDATION: take the narrowing branch -- it is pre-registered in MECH-018's own what_would_answer. EXP-0755 stays blocked_substrate until this is recorded, per its own 'ALL THREE land' condition. SECOND, INDEPENDENT FINDING for whoever queues the MECH-018 experiment, because it changes how readouts (i) and (ii) must be pre-registered: the EXP-0755 pre-flight predicted a SUCCESSFUL integration would drive evaluate() toward ~1.1x rbf (a monotone rescaling UP). Measured, it does the OPPOSITE. evaluate() = rbf_value + neural_value * 0.1, and training against rbf targets at jittered sample points (noise std = kernel_bandwidth = 1.0) drives the untrained Softplus head's roughly-constant ~0.7 pedestal to ~0, so evaluate() at the recorded harm locations converges DOWNWARD onto the pure rbf core: 0.167 -> 0.100 in a live sleep cycle, and a drop of 0.069-0.078 in each of 5 seeds, every time landing on rbf_core to 4 decimal places. Two consequences. (a) Readout (i) PRESERVATION: residue at harm locations DOES fall (about 37 percent of its pre-integration value at this scale), so a floor registered against pre-integration evaluate() would FAIL for a reason that has nothing to do with erasure -- the un-erasable rbf core is bit-identical (rbf_weight_abs_sum_delta exactly 0.0, active_mask unchanged, no gradient ever reaches rbf weights, pinned by contract C2/C4). The floor must be registered against the rbf core. (b) Readout (ii) SPECIFICITY RATIO: the drop is a near-CONSTANT pedestal removal, and subtracting a constant c from both terms of a ratio h/n with h > n > c RAISES that ratio arithmetically. So the specificity ratio will rise mechanically from pedestal removal alone, with no contextualisation whatsoever -- and the naive-decay comparator arm the claim already requires does NOT control for it, since uniform multiplicative decay is a different operation from constant subtraction. A pedestal-matched control is needed or (ii) is confounded.

items.summary: SD-020's text treats the ARC-016 precision weighting of the affective-harm PE target as unconditional; measurement shows it is correct at RUNTIME and destructive at TRAINING time, and the user has directed (real AskUserQuestion via orchestrate-20260918-1840-cloud4, 2026-09-19T02:31:55Z, OPTION I) that /governance apply the amendment -- this session was explicitly told NOT to edit claims.yaml itself. EVIDENCE: on the standard all-ON path the P0 affective-encoder warmup runs BEFORE the agent has any precision to couple to, so precision_norm = min(e3.current_precision/500, 3.0) sits at 0.004 (current_precision at its init 2.0, while the /500 divisor presupposes the ~95-100 of a trained agent) and attenuates the PE target ~250x to magnitude ~1e-06. Measured over 3 seeds: held-out lift over a constant-mean predictor -0.074 (readiness 1/3, and that one is numerical noise) at 0.004, versus +0.913 (3/3) with the coupling pinned to 1.0. The arms have IDENTICAL target coefficients of variation -- a rescale cannot change a CV -- so information content is provably unchanged and only scale moved; a pin sweep shows a cliff between 0.004 and 0.02 then a flat plateau over two further orders of magnitude, i.e. a numerical floor (gradients at target ~1e-06 are comparable to Adam's eps 1e-8), not a tuned optimum. PROPOSED WORDING, to append to SD-020's implementation_note verbatim: 'SCOPE AMENDMENT (2026-09-19, user decision OPTION I): the precision weighting of the affective-harm prediction-error target is a RUNTIME property, not a training-time one. It is correct while the agent is acting, when e3.current_precision reflects a real running variance; it is destructive during the SD-011 P0 affective-encoder warmup, which by construction runs before any precision has been earned, and where the coupling therefore multiplies the target by its floor (measured precision_norm 0.004, a ~250x attenuation) and reduces training to numerical noise. Training-time uses of this target must floor precision_norm; ree-v3 experiments/_lib/zharm_a_p0_warmup.py does so at 0.1 by default (ZHarmAP0Config.p0_precision_norm_floor), chosen mid-plateau on the measured sweep. This narrows WHERE the coupling applies and does not weaken the claim that anterior-insula affective PE is precision-weighted in the acting agent.' SUBSTRATE ALREADY LANDED (default change + 29 contracts + record): ree-v3 78397036 and 2d37ac56a1, REE_assembly 49353745ed, all on origin. Full detail: ree-v3 docs/substrate/SD-011-p0h-affective-encoder-warmup.md and the substrate_queue entry sd_zharm_a_warmup_optimizer_group (optioni_adoption_2026_09_19). Note for the same cycle: SD-011 needs NO re-specification -- the competing arm F (per-tick harm_exposure) was measured and did not clear (0/3), so the EXQ-241 D3 redundancy cost is not incurred.

items.summary: V3-EXQ-1060's LANDED docstring asserts 'InfoNCE is insensitive to a global scale/shift of the prediction, so it can improve while frozen-battery MSE does not move'. That is FALSE for this implementation: world_forward_contrastive_loss builds its logits from squared L2 DISTANCES, -||pred_j - target_i||^2/tau at tau=0.1 (ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py:359 and :396-403), not from a dot product or cosine -- a global scale changes every distance and a global shift leaves a non-cancelling cross term. Found by the V3-EXQ-1063 Step 4.5 red-team (fable 5.1) and verified against source before reporting. TWO CONSEQUENCES FOR GOVERNANCE. (1) The stated mechanism for a divergence between the two frozen-battery readouts is not the one the code can produce; a competing STEP-SIZE explanation is not excluded by any landed run -- cross_module_consolidation.py:155-162 builds a FRESH Adam per cycle, so 8 steps move each world-head weight by at most 8*cmc_lr = 0.008 REGARDLESS of gradient magnitude, and 1060's own landed min_world_head_max_abs_delta_on = 0.007899 is 98.7% of that bound, i.e. set by the optimiser rather than by the loss. (2) NEW AND DECISION-RELEVANT: the InfoNCE readout is pinned at its chance value ln(K). 1060's landed efficacy_infonce_pre_on = 4.15921 is ABOVE ln(64) = 4.158883, and its entire measured movement (0.009417) is 0.23% of ln(K) while the MSE readout moved 25% over the same cycle. This bears directly on the OPEN user decision about INV-063 leg B option C (re-point the DV from 701b MSE to SD-056 InfoNCE): on current evidence that would re-point it onto a statistic carrying no signal. V3-EXQ-1063 (queued 2026-09-19, ree-v3 61ff871548) measures the headroom per cell and marks its InfoNCE findings non-degenerate=false when pinned, scoped so it cannot vacate the MSE findings. items.summary: The blocked_substrate disposition recorded for EXP-0810 / EVB-1416 (MECH-066) at 2026-09-19T16:47:57Z by IGW-20260919-242's /queue-experiment twin names its substrate gap as 'no representation-isolation comparator arm, no coupling measure' -- and the literature pull completed on the SAME claim ~80 minutes later (REE_assembly origin/master 1e98ae94e8, GFLAG-0361) argues that a representation-isolation / coupling measure is the WRONG INSTRUMENT for MECH-066, so the named gap may not be a real blocker. Kaufman et al. 2014 (Nat Neurosci, PMID 24487233) show a single motor population carrying both the pre-commit and commit-driving computation with separation enforced geometrically at the readout: two channels can be MAXIMALLY OVERLAPPING in representation and still perfectly separated at the write boundary. MECH-066 itself explicitly PERMITS shared representations, so a comparator arm that isolates representations or measures inter-channel coupling tests something MECH-066 does not assert, and a low coupling measure would not confirm it while a high one would not falsify it. The instrument MECH-066 actually needs is a STATIC audit of the write topology -- does pre-commit simulated error ever reach a durable store? -- which needs no new comparator arm and no coupling metric, and is the same shape as DreamerV3's separation (Hafner et al. 2025, Nature, PMID 40175544), where the boundary is a property of which loss touches which parameters rather than any runtime statistic. Asked of governance: re-examine whether EXP-0810 is genuinely substrate-blocked, or blocked only against an instrument the claim does not require. NOTE the ordering dependency -- this should be considered AFTER GFLAG-0361's scope question, since a MECH-066 narrowed to protect only the world-veridical component changes what any write-topology audit must cover.

items.summary: SUPPLEMENT TO GFLAG-0364 (read them together; 0364 carries the proposed leg-B wording, this carries two numbers measured AFTER it was raised). NO claims.yaml edit. (1) THE READOUT'S CHANCE-PINNING IS A TEMPERATURE ARTIFACT AND IS CHEAP TO FIX. world_forward_contrastive_loss forms logits[i,j] = -||pred_j - target_i||^2 / tau (ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py:396-403) and defaults tau = 0.1 (:359). Measured on a converged base (conv_rel_drop 0.9980/0.9967/0.9992) the REPRESENTATION discriminates -- diagonal squared distance 1.5e-4..2.4e-4 against off-diagonal 2.1e-3..3.6e-3, i.e. the correct target is 10-15x closer than the average distractor -- but dividing distances of order 1e-3 by tau = 0.1 gives logit spreads of ~0.03, far too flat to separate. Headroom below ln(K) by temperature, per seed 42/123/456: tau=1.0 0.08/0.06/0.05%; tau=0.1 (shipped) 0.75/0.57/0.52%; tau=0.01 5.44/4.34/4.30%; tau=1e-3 23.88/21.61/23.45%; tau=1e-4 35.02/48.26/42.69%; tau=1e-5 numerically broken (loss ABOVE ln K). At tau = 1e-3 the readout clears V3-EXQ-1063's 5%-of-ln(K) readability floor by 4x on all three seeds. temperature is an EXPLICIT argument to the loss, so this is a readout re-specification, not a substrate change. IF /governance APPLIES 0364's re-point, THE WORDING SHOULD PIN THE READOUT TEMPERATURE -- at the shipped tau = 0.1 the InfoNCE readout cannot carry INV-063's C1/C2 at all. It should also state WHICH TASK leg B means: the helper's docstring says it is built for 'K sibling CEM candidates SHARING z_world_0 but differing in first action a_i' (action discrimination), whereas V3-EXQ-1060 and 1063 both call it on the frozen battery -- 64 DIFFERENT states carrying only 5 distinct action classes between them (measured histograms [14,11,11,14,14] / [18,12,9,15,10] / [11,13,11,16,13]) -- which is STATE-identity discrimination. Well-formed, but not the task the helper was designed for. (2) A UNITS CORRECTION, so it is not re-derived: the figure 0.2079 that has been circulating as 'what C2 requires' is 0.05 x ln(64) = the READABILITY floor V3-EXQ-1063 pre-registered (INFONCE_HEADROOM_FLOOR_FRAC), which asks whether the readout can carry a sign test at all. C2's 20%-of-highest-arm term is 0.20 x 3.171e-3 = 6.343e-4, in DV units. Different quantities. C2's BINDING term is 2 x the cross-seed SD of the ARM-TO-ARM DELTA, and V3-EXQ-1063 contains ZERO arm-to-arm differences (one arm per base/lever cell), so 1063 CANNOT set it and C2's registered rule needs no amendment -- it self-computes from the four-arm run's own data. The only related number 1063 records is the per-arm LEVEL SD, 2.458e-3 = 77.5% of the DV's own mean. For contrast the MSE alternative is NOISIER, not less: D3 (unconverged base) has SD/|mean| = 1.21. (3) UPSTREAM OF ALL OF IT: INV-063's P1 manipulation check now FAILS on the converged base as well -- relative spread 0.1369/0.1802/0.1082 against its 0.25 floor, 0/3 seeds, 0/3 strictly monotone, at V3-EXQ-798a's validated arm settings with convergence confirmed. P1 gates the INTAKE MANIPULATION, so no choice of leg-B readout gives the four-arm ladder an independent variable. Caveat: 798a's LANDED run got 0.483/0.659/0.685 and 3/3 at identical arm settings using a 5400-step E3-selection P0 where this used 3600 random-action steps, and MEL levels differ ~5x unexplained -- so P1's failure under 798a's OWN P0 is UNTESTED and that is the next measurement. items.summary: SD-036's CONFIRMING clause requires 'the per-stream effect magnitudes ordered by their registered taus (0.05 / 0.02 / 0.03)', and that test is ILL-POSED against the substrate it is written for, because it omits alpha. Post ree-v3 35e8969 the composed pole is (1 - alpha) * exp(-tau * gaba_tone) (LatentStack._gaba_state_blend, stack.py:1293, applied at :1655-1670), and sustain-ratio sensitivity to the pole grows sharply as the pole approaches 1. Registered values: z_harm_s tau 0.05 / alpha 0.5 (retained 0.5), z_harm_a tau 0.02 / alpha 0.2 (retained 0.8), z_beta tau 0.03 / alpha_shared 0.3 (retained 0.7, stack.py:1540). Expressed as a memory time constant -1/ln(pole), the 0.3-to-2.0 sweep moves z_harm_a by ~0.56 steps (4.36 -> 3.80) but z_harm_s by only ~0.15 (1.41 -> 1.26), so the substrate PREDICTS the largest sustain-ratio effect on the SMALLEST-tau stream. That is the reverse of what CONFIRMING scores as success, and it is what V3-EXQ-854 measured (z_harm_a, tau 0.02, is the only stream with any dose-response). Scoring the clause as literally written would therefore register a falsification of SD-036 whose cause is a modelling error in the claim text, not the mechanism. PROPOSED AMENDMENT (user decision D2=C, 2026-09-19T23:48:33Z: drop the test from the run and raise this flag instead): re-derive the predicted ordering from the composed pole (1-alpha)*exp(-tau*tone) rather than from tau alone, and re-word CONFIRMING to test that one scalar moves all streams by the amount the SHARED mechanism predicts. claims.yaml was NOT edited.

items.summary: INSTRUMENT DEFECT in the landed V3-EXQ-854 driver, found while building its successor. experiments/v3_exq_854_sd036_gaba_tone_dose_response.py:204 unpacks the environment step as '_, od, _, done, _ = env.step(...)', but CausalGridWorldV2.step returns (flat_obs, harm_signal, done, info, obs_dict) (causal_grid_world.py:2476 signature, :3709 return). The unpack therefore binds harm_signal to 'od' and the info DICT to 'done'. A non-empty info dict is truthy on every step, so the 'if done: env.reset()' branch fires EVERY step: the observation tape built by _record_tape is a sequence of post-reset first-steps rather than a trajectory. This does NOT invalidate V3-EXQ-854's C1/C3 verdicts, which are scored on record_stream_trajectories via StepHarness (correctly wired), but it does mean 854's READINESS CONTROL -- the measurement that discharges SD-036 precondition (i), 'any run must assert a non-zero sweep spread on EVERY stream it scores' -- was computed on a degraded tape. The recorded readiness spreads (0.1069 / 0.0997 / 0.1083) remain non-zero and above the 1e-3 floor, so the gate's verdict stands, but the tape is not the trajectory the methodology intends. The successor V3-EXQ-1068 fixes the unpack at both of its own sites. Recommend /governance decide whether 854's readiness figure needs re-measuring on a correct tape before it is cited again as the precondition-(i) discharge.

items.summary: V3-EXQ-1068 REFUSED A SECOND TIME at the red-team gate after the user's OPTION B amendment was applied; it is still NOT queued (ree-v3 df5a6c27 on origin/main, driver only). OPTION B WORKED FOR ITS TARGET: recomputed against V3-EXQ-854's landed trained trajectories, z_beta scored on the substituted shape_deviation_vs_off DV gives Spearman rho = -1.00 on 3/3 seeds, so the z_beta sign-inversion artifact that caused the first refusal is genuinely fixed. THE NEW BLOCK IS THE SAME CLASS OF ARTIFACT ON z_harm, by a different mechanism. z_harm fails on BOTH candidate DVs at full scale on every seed: sustain_ratio rho = +0.10 / +0.70 / -0.50 and negated shape_deviation rho = +1.00 / +0.80 / +0.30 (seeds 42/43/44). The shape_deviation sign is an INITIALISATION artifact -- z_harm is zero-initialised (stack.py:1290) and blended against zeros (stack.py:1655), so the decay-ON arm starts at ~0.5*e0*f while the OFF control starts at e0, and the max of the peak-normalised difference therefore lands at t=0 (argmax per tone [0,0,0,10,194] on seed 42, [0,0,0,0,0] on seed 43); because the ON peak falls with tone, the deviation FALLS with tone, the opposite of the mechanism. The pre-registered symmetric sign-inversion rule does not rescue it, because z_harm's fixed-tape rho is NOISY (-0.10 measured after a determinism fix) rather than reliably inverted, and substituting it would not help anyway. Independently, z_harm's TRUE tone effect was measured at 1.9e-4 / 6.4e-3 / 5.4e-3 sweep spread with observations and weights held fixed -- at or below the 1e-3 readiness floor -- whereas the 4.8e-2 to 1.5e-1 spread recorded in V3-EXQ-854 is closed-loop observation divergence between independent per-tone rollouts. So z_harm clears the readiness gate because the gate is measuring noise, is then scored, fails, and would carry the load-bearing criterion down to SD-036: weakens at non_degenerate: true -- a second false falsification. TWO SEPARATE BUGS WERE FIXED in the same pass and are on origin: the readiness gate was non-reproducible (fresh REEAgents with unseeded random encoders meant the substitution decision was an RNG draw; two readiness_control(42) calls in one process gave z_harm rho -0.2 then -0.8), and SD-011 could be recorded 'weakens' on an instrument limit without consulting the ARM_OFF positive control. Per the campaign's two-stops rule NO third decision chip was raised; this flag plus the session report is the record. items.summary: V3-EXQ-1068 REFUSED A THIRD TIME at the red-team gate; still NOT queued (driver on ree-v3 origin/main, DO-NOT-QUEUE status line). The user's 2026-09-20 resolvability decision was implemented in full -- a stream is scoreable only if its gaba_tone effect exceeds a MEASURED closed-loop noise floor taken from 10 seeded no-tone-change eval rollouts, with the null for the range-of-5 statistic built from all C(10,5) subset ranges and the floor set at its 0.95 quantile -- and in the dry run it behaved exactly as intended (z_harm excluded at signal/noise 0.42; z_harm_a 475 and z_beta 245 admitted, both rho -1.00). THE GATE NEVERTHELESS DOES NOT WORK, and the finding is verified from the driver's own dry-run manifest rather than argued: 9 of the 10 replicates are BIT-IDENTICAL, to each other AND to the UNSEEDED tone-1.0 sweep row (n_distinct_trajectories = 2 of 10 on all three streams), so the 252 subset ranges collapse to two values {0.0, 0.021743} and floor/median_null_range is exactly 2.000. A 0.95 quantile of a two-point distribution is not a 0.05 false-admission rate, and the reported signal-to-noise figures are artifacts of that degenerate null. CAUSE: the eval path is nearly deterministic -- the only RNG consumer reached is hippocampal/module.py:2276, and whether that candidate noise reaches the action is gated by E3, since non-E3 ticks return the held action (agent.py:7381) and committed ticks step the committed trajectory (agent.py:6685-6686), so seeding the replicates is inert. CONSEQUENCE, which is the previous refusal returning through the very gate built to prevent it: if a seed's trained agent holds its committed trajectory across the full-scale eval, all ten replicates coincide, the floor is 0.0, the test 'tone_range > floor' passes for any non-zero spread, and z_harm is ADMITTED carrying the unordered 4.8e-2 to 1.5e-1 spread measured in V3-EXQ-854 -- it then fails the monotonicity bar and the run records SD-036: weakens at non_degenerate: true. TWO FURTHER FINDINGS, recorded not blocking: exchangeability is broken by mechanism, because re-selection is triggered by the z_harm_a norm through the MECH-091 urgency interrupt (agent.py:6688-6689, :6754) so the manipulation itself sets how much replicate noise each tone sees (measured 1.8x-2.4x tone dependence), and the floor is measured at the baseline tone only; and sd011_instrument_control_ok is an any() over OFF seeds on two of C2's four bands while C2 requires 2 of 3 ON seeds on all four, so SD-011 can still be recorded weakens when the validated regime is itself marginal. A CHEAP PRE-REGISTRABLE FIX EXISTS for whoever resumes, using quantities already in the manifest: require n_distinct_trajectories >= 8 across the replicates (and that replicate 0 is not bit-equal to the tone-1.0 sweep row) before treating a floor as measurable, else record the stream noise_floor_not_measurable and do not admit it; the dry run fails that check today at 2 of 10. Per the campaign's standing instruction a third BLOCKING verdict is a STOP: the design was NOT re-worked in-session and NO further decision chip was raised. This item now waits for /governance to apply GFLAG-0372..0379.

Measured 2026-09-20 on V3-EXQ-798a's configuration (the regime V3-EXQ-1069 established as the one where P1 is gradeable), converged base conv_rel_drop 0.9899, K=64 so ln(K)=4.158883: HEADROOM AND THE ASSERTED DIRECTION TRADE OFF AGAINST EACH OTHER IN THE READOUT TEMPERATURE, with no overlap. Readability (headroom > 5% of ln K, V3-EXQ-1063's pre-registered condition) requires tau <= 0.01; a POSITIVE across-sleep delta -- which is what C1 leg B's 'ACROSS-SLEEP IMPROVEMENT' means -- requires tau >= 0.03. Full ladder, seed 42: tau=10 headroom 0.01% delta +1.76e-05; tau=1 0.06% +1.75e-04; tau=0.1 (shipped) 0.62% +1.55e-03; tau=0.03 2.02% +3.56e-03; tau=0.01 5.65% -7.18e-04; tau=0.003 14.61% -7.68e-02; tau=0.001 (the value GFLAG-0364's amendment would pin) 18.54% -3.89e-01; tau=1e-4 numerical breakdown. So at the ratified pin the readout has ample headroom but sleep makes it WORSE -- the same condition that disqualified the 701b MSE readout and was the entire reason for the re-point. This looks STRUCTURAL rather than a tuning accident: as tau falls the softmax sharpens toward a hard nearest-neighbour test that a sleep pass degrades on an MSE-converged head (GFLAG-0360's E1-vs-E2 argument), and as tau rises the loss flattens toward ln(K) where every delta is tiny and positive but the readout carries no information. LIMITS, stated: n=1 seed (seed 123's P0 was cut by a shell timeout), P0 was 1800 steps not the 5400 the ladder would use, and one sleep cycle -- enough to say do not spend ~8h on a design whose leg B may be unreadable, NOT enough to say leg B is unreadable. ALSO WITHDRAWN HERE, so it is not re-derived: an earlier probe this session measured InfoNCE 23.99 vs ln(64) at tau=1e-3 under 798a's config and I read it as the pin failing to transfer between latent-dimension regimes; that probe ran with NO P0 and the reading does NOT hold on a converged base, where the same tau gives 18.54% headroom. /governance should weigh GFLAG-0364's proposed wording against this: if leg B stays InfoNCE the amendment must say which tau AND must confront that no tau currently gives both readability and the asserted direction. Full options and evidence: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/inv063_legb_tau_bind_20260920.md (f46b2accc1 on origin/master). Cross-refs GFLAG-0355, 0359, 0360, 0364, 0367. The four-arm ladder was NOT queued and V3-EXQ-1071 is reserved but unused.

items.summary: A follow-up literature pull read the PRIMARY human group-size experiments behind the Galke et al. 2022 workshop entry (REE_assembly 5d3691b782d, five new entries in evidence/literature/targeted_review_arc_099) and the primaries disagree with ARC-099's enabling-condition inventory in three ways: (1) partner variation is listed at the wrong GRAIN -- Raviv et al. 2019 Cognition Study 2 shows number of distinct partners drives structure (b=0.04, t=6.37, p<0.001) while an expanding meaning space adds nothing unique (p=0.96), and the Proc R Soc B mediation shows input variability survives while shared history does not, so an ecology with multiple but behaviourally identical partners satisfies the item and delivers nothing; (2) the inventory contains no instance of the KIND of condition that actually repaired the effect in artificial agents -- Rita et al. 2022 measured population size as inert in a homogeneous Lewis game (Spearman -0.44/-0.15/-0.52/-0.14 over six seeds) and recovered it only via speaker/listener relative LEARNING-RATE asymmetry, a property of learning dynamics that no capability checklist can see; (3) of the two conditions Galke et al. proposed adding, only role alternation has any evidence and it is artificial-agent-side (the one human interaction-protocol test, Raviv et al. 2020 Cognitive Science, 168 adults in 21 groups, is a NULL on network structure), while bounded memory has no successful causal manipulation in either literature and is better reframed as a compressibility pressure deliverable by more than one ecology configuration. Recorded unresolved: Galke and Raviv 2024 gloss Michel et al. 2023 as tying sender and receiver into one agent, whereas that paper's own abstract frames its mechanism as partitioning to limit co-adaptation -- different claims with different implications for a role-alternation item, and the full paper is behind an OpenReview browser-verification wall and was not read. This flag routes the finding only; claims.yaml was deliberately not touched, since amending the inventory is a /governance disposition.

items.summary: CORRECTION TO GFLAG-0379 -- read this before acting on that flag's DEMOTE recommendation for MECH-204 Option A. GFLAG-0379 reported that the sleep WRITEBACK moves E3 running variance AWAY from the realised prediction-error variance in 9/9 (guard OFF) and 8/9 (guard ON) cycles with rv 18-82x above realised PE, and concluded Option A 'appears already falsified -> DEMOTE'. That measurement is SOUND but its REGIME WAS NOT STATED, and stating it changes the disposition. It was taken where episodes ended by death in 6-15 waking ticks, so rv never converged between sleep cycles and sat 18-82x above realised PE as a sawtooth artefact. Re-measured in a survivable regime where rv DOES converge (episodes 200 ticks, rv/realised-PE = 1.0), the guard-ON de-calibration is essentially ZERO: mean relative displacement -0.001 measured, +0.0001 analytic, against +1.55 to +2.01 for guard OFF. MECHANISM, which is the load-bearing part and is analytic rather than empirical: with the guard ON the recalibration target is serotonin._persistent_zero_point, an EMA of current_precision = 1/rv, i.e. A LAGGED FUNCTION OF rv ITSELF. Recalibrating rv toward a lagged function of rv is near-idempotent, so it CANNOT de-calibrate a converged rv. An adversarial sweep over eight rv trajectories (stationary, 10x and 100x monotonic decay, 5x step collapse and rise, alternating, 20x spike, sawtooth) gives a guard-ON mean relative displacement in [-0.15, +0.062] -- never approaching a 0.25 firing bar. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE DISPOSITION: the de-calibration GFLAG-0379 recorded is attributable to (a) the precision_init cold-start sentinel, which the landed F1 guard removes, and (b) rv being far from its own lagged mean, i.e. non-convergence -- NOT to Option A being wrong in principle. The evidence therefore supports the guard FIXING the identified defect, and does NOT support demoting Option A on its own. Option A remains untested against a genuine waking drift source (SD-076), which is the only substrate mechanism that can make rv diverge from realised PE while the guard is on; that test is what is still owed. Full derivation and measurements: REE_assembly evidence/planning/exq541d_redteam_blocking_refusal_staged_20260919.md section 7. Related: GFLAG-0379, GFLAG-0377, GFLAG-0369.

items.summary: ARC-104's absolute wording ('there must be NO path by which symbolic/linguistic content overwrites or suppresses a harm signal') is not supported by the first literature pull for this claim (REE_assembly a4a0fa3c2d, 6 entries, evidence/literature/targeted_review_arc_104): Spisak et al. 2026 Nat Commun (IPD meta-analysis, n=409) found verbal suggestion ALONE still produced significant analgesia and insula/putamen deactivation while sparing S1 -- only conditioning reduced S1 -- and Eippert et al. 2009 Science reports placebo reducing spinal dorsal-horn nociceptive activity outright, so biology implements a graded, bounded top-down path to the harm signal rather than the absence of one. Governance should consider whether ARC-104 should be reworded from an absolute prohibition to a LAYERED guard (symbolic input may condition the evaluative prior but must not write the primary harm registration), which the same evidence supports well; note the supportive half rests partly on a null in a smaller subset (5 studies, n=147) and so is a power-limited finding, and note the same rewording question applies to sibling claim ARC-103 and to the parent invariant INV-007.

items.summary: BLOCKING DEFECT IN INV-063'S REGISTERED C1 LEG A, found by V3-EXQ-1071's Step 4.5 red-team and verified against source. NO claims.yaml edit; the four-arm ladder was NOT queued. ALL THREE of leg A's registered DVs are transforms of the SAME SCALAR that P1's manipulation check gates on. Chain, verified: (1) agent.py:10902 does metrics.update({f'e3_{k}': v for k,v in e3_metrics.items()}), so the driver's MEL -- metrics['e3_prediction_error'], the quantity P1 requires monotone with spread >= 0.25 -- IS e3_metrics['prediction_error']; (2) agent.py:10985-10987, MECH-205 reads that same scalar and keeps _pe_ema as an EMA of it; (3) agent.py:10812-10814 and :10848, leg A's A2 'realised surprise_weight at the replay call' = drive_state[VALENCE_SURPRISE] = min(1.0, _pe_ema * 5.0), a monotone transform of EMA(MEL); (4) agent.py:10988-10991, leg A's A1 'count of VALENCE_SURPRISE residue writes' increments when pe_mag - _pe_ema > pe_surprise_threshold (1e-5, config.py:3692) -- a threshold-count of MEL against its own EMA, and V3-EXQ-1069's landed MELs of 1.6e-5..4.3e-5 sit 1.6x-4.3x that threshold, exactly the level-driven regime; (5) config.py:3842-3843, valence_harm_enabled and valence_liking_enabled are both default-False and are not set by V3-EXQ-798a's _make_agent, so VALENCE_SURPRISE is the ONLY valence channel written, and leg A's A3 start-selection priority is dot(evaluate_valence(z), drive_state) whose surprise weight IS A2 -- so A3 carries A2 multiplicatively. CONSEQUENCE: C1 leg A is P1 RE-READ (a monotone leg A follows from P1 up to sampling), and C2 -- the LOAD-BEARING knee, the thing that makes INV-063 distinct from INV-050 -- becomes a test of whether the four world_rule_shift_interval values {10,25,60,0} happen to be SPACED with a larger MEL step at the low end. P1 constrains monotonicity and total spread but says NOTHING about spacing. Under either outcome no reader could attribute the result to 'offline function has a floor' rather than to 'interval 60->0 is a bigger MEL step than 10->25'. Concrete: applying V3-EXQ-1071's own _knee rule to V3-EXQ-1069's LANDED MELs already yields knee=True on seed 456 (excess 9.6e-6 against a 9.4e-6 margin) -- the knee pattern is present in the manipulation check before any DV is read. THIS IS A PROPERTY OF THE REGISTERED CLAIM TEXT, not of the implementation: the driver measures exactly the three quantities INV-063's C1 names. So the remedy is registry-side. /governance and the user should choose between re-specifying leg A's DVs as a SELECTIVITY measure rather than a LEVEL one (the claim's own stated intent is 'surprise-gating has nothing left to prioritise', which wants e.g. the share of replay starts captured by the top-priority bin, or the rank correlation between replay priority and episode PE -- both can fall while MEL rises), running leg B alone (but GFLAG-0382's tau bind leaves leg B liable to its ratified sign-inversion refusal, so likely no verdict at all), or converting INV-063 to substrate_conditional via its own escape hatch. FOUR independent measured preconditions have now failed on this claim: leg B's 701b MSE readout degrades across sleep on a converged base (V3-EXQ-1063, 9/9 cells); the InfoNCE readout trades headroom against direction with no overlap (GFLAG-0382); P1 holds on 2/3 seeds not 3/3 (V3-EXQ-1069); and now leg A is not independent of P1. Full analysis, the three further fixable defects in my own driver, and four options with a recommendation: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/inv063_legA_dv_circularity_20260920.md (4d28f21f2f on origin/master). Cross-refs GFLAG-0355, 0359, 0360, 0364, 0367, 0382. The V3-EXQ-1071 driver is written and landed on ree-v3 origin/main but is deliberately NOT in experiment_queue.json.

Pinning it would register an assertion against the only in-regime measurement of it. The proposed text therefore states leg B FUNCTIONALLY: any readout must be (i) READABLE on a converged base and (ii) MOVE IN THE ASSERTED DIRECTION at the same setting that satisfies (i); both candidates measured to date fail one of these; supplying a readout meeting both IS the substrate dependency this leg is blocked on. That matches the epistemic_category substrate_conditional conversion already applied under GFLAG-0390. Limits carried, not buried: GFLAG-0382 is n=1 seed, 1800-step P0, one sleep cycle, which licenses declining to REGISTER the pin but not asserting leg B is permanently unreadable, which is why the text states a requirement rather than a verdict. TWO CORRECTIONS THE PROPOSAL ALSO CARRIES, both found by reading the field and neither previously flagged. (1) GFLAG-0355 is right that the E1 label is wrong, but a bare E1 to E2 relabel COLLIDES: INV-063 excludes a different E2 leg (E2 motor-sequence learning, MECH-457 competence floor) two paragraphs below, so the proposed text names the head agent.e2.world_forward and says explicitly which leg it is not. items.summary: GOV-SUBPATH-1 ADJUDICATED at the 2026-09-22 governance cycle (user-approved). The audit reports 19 completed runs whose drivers import ree_core/policy/tonic_vigor.py after substrate_queue entry MECH-320 (severity corrupting, added_utc 2026-05-11T17:24:22Z) recorded its defect. The defect, from V3-EXQ-571: 'All diversity bias components (dacc, lateral_pfc, ofc, curiosity, tonic_vigor) contribute 0.0 to E3 temporal variance; forward model F dominates 88-89%. Bias channel present in substrate but not propagating to E3 selection', with the target 'each bias component must contribute > 0.01 variance fraction before functional evidence for MECH-313/314/320 is interpretable'. FOURTEEN OF THE NINETEEN CANNOT BE AFFECTED and need no re-review: they are scoring-inert (evidence_direction non_contributory or unknown) or claimless pure diagnostics -- v3_exq_542a x3 (ARC-062/MECH-309, non_contributory), 816b/816c/816d/830/839 (claim_ids empty), 816/820/867/867b (unknown), 867a and 938 (non_contributory). FIVE ARE SCORING AND WARRANT RE-REVIEW, in priority order. (1) HIGHEST -- v3_exq_544a_mech313_noise_floor_substrate_readiness_v3_20260529T154903Z, evidence_direction SUPPORTS on MECH-313 + ARC-065: MECH-313 is named BY ID in MECH-320's own failure_record as a claim whose functional evidence is uninterpretable until the bias components clear the 0.01 variance bar, and this run is a substrate-READINESS diagnostic that returned supports. A readiness PASS taken on a channel the defect says is silently contributing zero is the exact shape the audit exists to catch. (2) and (3) OPPOSITE DIRECTION, and the more dangerous one -- v3_exq_844_mech321_r4_midexec_task_effect_20260801T013315Z and v3_exq_919_mech321_harm_aware_selection_unconditional_wholeepisode, both evidence_direction WEAKENS on MECH-321. A false weakens on a claim is worse than a false supports because nothing downstream re-tests it. (4) v3_exq_904_arc070_decomposition_trigger_selectivity, SUPPORTS on ARC-070 -- third tier: ARC-070 is not named in the failure_record, but it is the policy-decomposition umbrella over MECH-321. (5) the MECH-321 weakens pair should be read together with 844/919 rather than separately. ROUTING: these five need /failure-autopsy adjudication against the MECH-320 defect, not a governance direction stamp -- governance does not stamp a direction without a confirmed autopsy, and it has deliberately stamped nothing here. THE QUESTION FOR THE PRODUCER, and only the producer can answer it: does GOV-FROZEN-1 need a recognised 'resolved by ratified disposition, no adjudicating run' route -- e.g. a control_waived_with_basis field the audit reads -- or should these three legs record something that genuinely satisfies the control condition? items.summary: INV-105's latent-access evidence ladder has SEVEN rungs, but four separate claims each describe themselves as adding 'an EIGHTH' rung to it -- MECH-548 (recurrently stable), MECH-555 (reference-frame mediation), GOV-CONTRACT-3 (reduction admissibility) and INV-110 -- while MECH-556 describes a 'NINTH'. The ordinals are therefore mutually inconsistent and at least three of the four eighth-rung claims must be wrong about their position, so any reader resolving 'the eighth rung' gets a different answer depending on which claim they read first. Found during the 2026-09-22 ingestion of docs/thoughts/2026-09-19_dynamic_consensus_post_translation_integration.md; the newly registered MECH-578 proposes a further rung (RECIPROCALLY RECONCILED) and deliberately carries NO ordinal rather than compounding the collision, so it is waiting on this adjudication. Needs a decision on whether the ladder is genuinely extensible by ordinal at all, or whether rungs above the original seven should be named-only.
items.resolution_note: WITHDRAWN BY THE RAISING SESSION -- the premise was FALSE, and it duplicates an already-resolved, user-approved ruling. Raised 2026-09-22T11:38Z by compassionate-pike-fe9174-consensus during a thought-ingestion pass; withdrawn ~40 min later after a digestion agent checked the five cited claims verbatim and the raising session independently re-verified every one. The summary asserted that four claims each describe themselves as adding an EIGHTH rung to INV-105's ladder and MECH-556 a NINTH. Checked against live claim text, that is wrong on FOUR of the five: MECH-548 IS a genuine eighth-rung proposal for INV-105's ladder ('Adds an EIGHTH rung to INV-105's ladder, RECURRENTLY STABLE') and is the ONLY one -- and it was ALREADY ADJUDICATED by GFLAG-0235 (resolved, USER-APPROVED 2026-09-10, REE_assembly c8116c399b, gov-flagbacklog-20260909), which chose forward-reference over amendment and confirmed INV-105 lists exactly seven distinctions; MECH-555 registers failure class RF-F as 'an eighth entry in the LOCATION DOC'S F1-F7 ROUTING TABLE' -- a different artifact from the ladder; MECH-556 registers TG-F as 'a ninth entry' in that SAME F-table, correctly following MECH-555's eighth, i.e. a consistent sequence rather than a collision; GOV-CONTRACT-3 explicitly DECLINES a rung ('stated here rather than as an eighth rung, to avoid a second ladder that would invite collapse with the first'); INV-110 claims no rung and cites the GFLAG-0235 ruling as governing precedent. ROOT CAUSE, recorded because it is reusable: the raising session grepped the literal tokens 'eighth'/'ninth' across titles+notes and read a collision into hits that in fact span TWO DIFFERENT ENUMERATIONS (INV-105's 7-rung ladder and the location doc's F1-F7 failure-class table) plus one explicit declination. A token match is not a referent match. THERE IS NO ORDINAL COLLISION and governance is owed nothing here. ONE REAL RESIDUE, carried forward rather than dropped: MECH-578's registered TITLE cites this now-withdrawn premise as its reason for carrying no ordinal. The no-ordinal DECISION stands and is if anything better supported -- GOV-CONTRACT-3's 'rather than as an eighth rung' is a live precedent for named-not-numbered, and the deeper reason is that 'reciprocally reconciled' is a property of a COUPLED PAIR'S DYNAMICS, not of a VARIABLE'S STATUS in a latent space, and it dissociates from INV-105's ladder in BOTH directions (generic recurrence can produce tau_agree>tau_disagree with nothing at rung 4 bridgeable, per MECH-578's own falsifier 2; and a feedforward bridge can reach rung 7 with no reciprocal reconciliation). The title correction is being put to the user in the same session under the digestion pass that found this.

items.summary: INV-069's registered what_would_answer names a non-degeneracy precondition that cannot be satisfied in V3: 'z_self must reach behaviour (use_self_viability_weighting ON, DR-10)'. Measured against live ree-v3: DR-10 is INERT in V3 -- e3_selector.py:1771-1773 requires the flag AND a driver-supplied per-candidate self_viability cost AND self_viability_weight != 0 (default 0.0); nothing auto-populates that cost (the sole setter is the driver-facing set_injected_self_viability(), agent.py:4145/4158); config.py:2058-2061 and docs/architecture/dr10_z_self_in_e3_viability.md:101 both call the z_self-derived auto-source a 'documented ecological follow-on (NOT v1)'; and that doc's line 16 reads 'Generation: v4 (off the V3 critical path; promotes nothing in V3; excluded from the V3 closure %)'. The only native v3 alternative, use_gated_policy (z_self is a default discriminator stream whose per-candidate score_bias composes before E3.select), was piloted as a substitute channel and is ALSO degenerate at the default operating point: candidate features collapse to bit-identical across all 32 candidates (pairwise dist 0.000000e+00), so the gated bias is EXACTLY constant across candidates and therefore rank-invariant -- 0/73 ticks showed any ranking change even between the gating extremes w=0 and w=1. This reproduces the V3-EXQ-614e autopsy root cause (2026-06-07, 'proposer first-step z_world collapses to cross-candidate spread ~0'). Applying that autopsy's documented remedy (candidate_summary_source=e2_world_forward + use_modulatory_selection_authority) restores reachability (structural 73/73 under normalize_score_bias_to_e3_range) but realised movement under a 0.5x||z_self|| perturbation was only 1/73 ticks, because z_self reaches the bias solely through a scalar gating weight that moved by 8e-5 (max 3.8e-4). CAVEAT on that last figure: GatedPolicy's discriminator requires a dedicated optimizer (V3-EXQ-543b/543e, LR 5e-4) which the pilot did not run, so the realised number characterises an UNTRAINED discriminator and is not itself a verdict. ACTION REQUESTED: amend INV-069's what_would_answer -- its behavioural leg is not measurable in V3 as written through either channel; the coherence leg IS fully runnable and non-degenerate (per_stream_vs['z_self'] sits off its 1.0 ceiling at mean 0.959/0.965, sd ~0.008, and dips 0.9648 -> 0.846 then recovers to 0.893 under perturbation, which is the WWA's own arm-(a) confirming signature). items.summary: GFLAG-0371's refusal of EXP-1394/V3-EXQ-1066 rests partly on the clause 'filling the window would pool rv across ~35 episode boundaries, so it would not be the within-run distribution the estimator is specified against'. That clause is NOT supported by the estimator's source and should be withdrawn or restated before /governance answers the open construct question left by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1070a_2026-09-22 section 8 ('is ARC-029's commitment bar a within-run drift-tracking quantile or a cross-episode one?'). VERIFIED AT SOURCE 2026-09-22: the variance-tracking bar's window is a bounded deque built once (ree-v3 ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:529/536, lazily at :3959-3964), appended every select call (:4090), and NEVER cleared -- there is no episode-boundary reset anywhere in ree_core, and the only other references are read-only reads in the 1066 and 1070a drivers. The bar is exp(trend_at_now + quantile_q(residuals)) over ONE least-squares log-linear detrend across the whole window (:938 ff). The estimator is therefore CROSS-EPISODE BY CONSTRUCTION and carries no episode-local specification that pooling could violate; the build record's phrase 'within-run drift' (arc029_variance_tracking_commit_bar_build_20260918.md, and the :844 docstring) means within-ROLLOUT drift, which is exactly what the detrend term exists to absorb. ARC-029's own what_would_answer points the same way -- it requires 'within-run alternation ... in one agent and seed' and a bar 'calibrated to the run's own measured variance distribution' (run, not episode). WHAT SURVIVES, restated as the sharper question: not a SPECIFICATION objection but a VALIDITY one -- does a single log-linear detrend adequately describe a window spanning the 15-39 episode resets measured in 1070a section 5, and does it hold on the ALTERNATING arm? 1070a is the STATIC arm (breath_period=0), so its occupancy readings (committed_step_fraction 0.471-0.549, bar_in_force 30/30, mean_committed_run_length 3.52-9.38 vs a floor of 3.0) do not settle the alternating case, and are additionally weak evidence because the detrended bar is contract-pinned to fire at ~q. This flag does NOT revive V3-EXQ-1066: that driver could not run at L0/L1 as written (WARM_EPISODE_CAP=30 against the 39 episodes needed at L0, env hard-coded to the lineage kwargs, P3 counting harm EVENTS rather than SNR), and it also does not disturb the 1070a autopsy's withdrawal of its L0/L1 residual on the static-arm and contract-pinning grounds, which are untouched by this finding. It bears ONLY on the second of the three withdrawal reasons in that autopsy's section 4, which cites GFLAG-0371 in terms and is therefore circular if this clause falls. Raised by /diagnose-errors on V3-EXQ-1066 2026-09-22 at user request to revisit the ARC-029 environment decision; the finding is that the ENV operating point is not the live question (1070a section 5 measures the bind as unresolvable along the env ladder: softening lengthens episodes, which shrinks the window's episode span and simultaneously drives harm_snr through the P3 floor).
items.resolution_note: RULED 2026-09-23 by governance cycle governance-pause-20260923-1741. GFLAG-0421, GFLAG-0416 and GFLAG-0354 were taken TOGETHER as one ARC-029 decision rather than separately, because 0421's finding (the MECH-108 oscillator cannot fire at this lineage's operating point) is what makes 0416's 'or' question load-bearing, and 0354 corrects the same claim's falsifier text. Both mechanisms were RE-VERIFIED AT SOURCE this cycle, not taken on report. (1) OSCILLATOR STRUCK AS INERT: Clock.reset() sets _breath_phase_step = 0 (ree-v3 ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py:231); REEAgent.reset() calls it (agent.py:3718); the sweep fires only while _breath_phase_step >= breath_period - sweep_duration (clock.py:120) and the counter advances once per env step (clock.py:170). Any ARC-029 successor must name the variance-tracking quantile commit bar; naming the oscillator is a design error, not an option. (2) POOLING CLAUSE WITHDRAWN: _commit_gate_variance_window is a bounded deque built once (e3_selector.py:844/881) and nothing in ree_core clears it, so the window is cross-episode BY CONSTRUCTION and GFLAG-0371's 'would not be the within-run distribution the estimator is specified against' clause has no referent. Withdraws that ONE clause only -- failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1070a's L0/L1 withdrawal stands on its other two independent reasons and V3-EXQ-1066 stays unrevived. (3) NOT UNBLOCKED: the ARC-029 successor remains blocked on a genuinely open design question this ruling deliberately does not decide -- under bar-alone the natural control (static absolute threshold) is degenerate at a trained operating point (occupancy 1.0000, V3-EXQ-063a). items.summary: STRUCTURAL FINDING, verified at source 2026-09-22: the MECH-108 BreathOscillator CANNOT FIRE at the ARC-029 lineage's own operating point, so any ARC-029 design whose manipulation is the sweep is testing nothing. MECHANISM: Clock.reset() sets _breath_phase_step = 0 (ree-v3 ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py:231, its own comment 'MECH-108: reset breath cycle state across episodes'); REEAgent.reset() calls it (agent.py:3718); every driver in this family calls agent.reset() per episode. The sweep is active only while _breath_phase_step >= breath_period - sweep_duration (clock.py:120), and the counter advances once per env step (clock.py:170). So the sweep fires only if an EPISODE is long enough to reach that phase. MEASURED at rung L1 from the V3-EXQ-1070a manifest: mean episode length 7.99-13.97 env steps across the six L1 cells (min_episode_length 5-6), against a sweep that at the pre-registered breath_period=25 / sweep_duration=5 begins at phase step 20. It is NEVER reached. A run would have reported 'alternating arm indistinguishable from static' -- a confident null on a manipulation that never happened. This is the Step 2.5d INERT shape and it was caught before any driver was written. GENERALISES BEYOND ONE PARAMETER CHOICE: breath_period must be shorter than the episode, but L1 episodes are only 7.0-8.8 SELECT CALLS long while 1070a's own mean_committed_run_length is already 4.56-6.62, so a committed run fills most of an episode and there is no room for a within-episode alternation between two regimes of >= 3 ticks. Shrinking sweep_duration far enough to fire turns the sweep into isolated de-committed SELECTIONS rather than the uncommitted WINDOWS ARC-029's text describes. This is the 1070a-section-5 P1/P3 bind reappearing in the ARM rather than the bar: the env that keeps harm_snr above the P3 floor has episodes too short to host the oscillation. USER DECISION 2026-09-22 on this finding: drop the oscillator and treat the variance-tracking bar alone as the manipulation, which ARC-029's what_would_answer permits ('the variance-tracking quantile commitment bar, OR a MECH-108 BreathOscillator sweep'). That makes GFLAG-0416's open construct question load-bearing rather than incidental -- governance must rule on the 'or' before an ARC-029 successor can be designed. CONSEQUENCE, and the actionable gap: with the oscillator dropped, V3-EXQ-1070a already answers everything the planned instrument probe would have asked (P1 holds 6/6 at L1; |occupancy - q| <= 0.0658; residual dispersion recorded), so NO PROBE WAS QUEUED and EXQ id 1074 was reserved and released. What IS unmeasured is ARC-029's actual falsifier: the 1070a manifest carries mean_harm_per_step / harm_snr / sd_harm_per_step but NO committed-vs-uncommitted split (harm_per_step_committed, harm_per_step_uncommitted, n_steps_committed, n_steps_uncommitted all absent).
