items.summary: V3-EXQ-1078 REFUSED at /queue-experiment Step 2.5d (falsifier-runnability, INERT): INV-069's COHERENCE leg is also only half-runnable -- arm (b) (FROZEN MAINTENANCE) is structurally degenerate on the DV the what_would_answer names, which no prior session measured. GFLAG-0414 established that the BEHAVIOURAL leg is dead in both channels; the 2026-09-23 human ruling to queue coherence-only rested on the premise that the coherence leg is sound, and that premise holds for arm (a) but NOT arm (b). PROOF (not a measurement artifact): the DV per_stream_vs['z_self'] is computed in ree_core/hippocampal/module.py:3813-3817 as err = ||z_curr - z_prev||/(||z_curr||+eps); score = clip(1-err,0,1); vs = EMA(score, tau=0.1). Arm (b) freezes z_self, so z_curr == z_prev EXACTLY, so err = 0 and score = 1.0 (the instrument's MAXIMUM) on every frozen tick. The manipulation zeroes the very increment that forms the DV's numerator, so a frozen self can only ever score HIGHER coherence than a live one, at every operating point -- this is DV-symmetry invariance, not a tuning problem. MEASURED (freeze hook verified engaged: frozen ||dz_self||max = 0.00000000 in all 12 cells; seeds 42/43/45 x windows 5/10/20/40, matched twin-build controls): freeze-minus-live delta was POSITIVE in 12 of 12 cells, range +0.0023 to +0.0122, per-window means +0.0029/+0.0079/+0.0035/+0.0068 -- against the DV's own unmanipulated within-run variability of ~0.005-0.008 (baseline sd ~0.008 from the 2026-09-22 pilot; the seed-42 live trace swings 0.9906->0.9886->0.9872->0.9860 with no manipulation at all). So the effect is sign-locked by construction AND inside the noise band. VERDICT ALIASING on top: the WWA maps 'coherence DRIFTS from the live-process control' to CONFIRMING and 'a frozen self preserves coherence as well as the live process does' to FALSIFYING, and a small positive delta satisfies BOTH readings -- one measurement, opposite claim verdicts. SECOND FINDING: the live process self-settles, so LIVE ||dz_self|| decays toward zero within ~10 ticks of episode start and LIVE per_stream_vs['z_self'] itself saturates (mean 0.9908 at window 20, 0.9925 at window 40; 17.5 percent of live ticks already exceed 0.99) -- the WWA's own non-degeneracy precondition ('it saturates at 1.0 when z_self is constant, so a pinned readout detects nothing') therefore bites the LIVE control too at longer windows, which the 2026-09-22 pilot's episode-averaged mean of 0.958/0.965 concealed. Candidate substitute arm-(b) DVs were measured and are NOT obviously alive either: per_stream_vs on the other tracked streams (z_world, z_beta) moved by EXACTLY 0.000000 under the z_self freeze, and ||z_self_frozen - z_self_live|| was constant to 6 d.p. across 20 ticks in the settled regime. ARM (a) IS UNAFFECTED and remains live and non-degenerate (perturbation dip 0.9648 -> 0.846, ~15 baseline sd, with measured recovery to 0.8926 over 8 ticks). ACTION REQUESTED: amend INV-069's what_would_answer for the COHERENCE leg as well -- its arm (b) needs either a DV that the freeze does not annihilate or an explicit restatement, and until then the claim's CONFIRMING condition ('Both together, sign-consistent across >=3 seeds') is unreachable in V3 even coherence-only. No experiment was queued; V3-EXQ-1078 left free and its reservation released. A decision chip was raised for the human rather than this session picking a substitute DV.

items.summary: SCOPE GAP in the falsifier-runnability family, plus one draft candidate claim (GOV-CRITBAR-1) for /governance to accept, revise or reject. Full analysis: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/claim_synthesis_dv_reachability_20260923.md (commit b5a2cddd48, verified on origin/master). FINDING 1 (the gap): /queue-experiment Step 2.5d and /implement-substrate Step 3h -- both landed 2026-09-22 under dec-20260921T044147-GOV-UNWRITTEN-1 option (b) -- define their falsifier-runnability trace on 'the claim's what_would_answer / pre-registered falsifier', so a run with claim_ids: [] has no subject for the trace and falls outside the gate entirely. V3-EXQ-1075 (validates_substrate SD-PP-B5, claim_ids: [] deliberately) is the measured instance: its criteria A1..A4 were authored ad hoc in the driver, it was the ONE of four 2026-09-23 design failures NOT caught by a pilot, and the same blindness is recorded independently in its own autopsy ('C1/C2/C3 returned inapplicable (claim-keyed; claim_ids: []) ... those checks were structurally blind'). This is a negative-instrument defect in the governance layer per negative_instrument_audit_20260922.md: 'nothing to check' is indistinguishable from 'nothing found', and it is concentrated on claim-free substrate-validation diagnostics -- exactly the population that sets its own criteria with no registry review. Proposed remedy is a SHARPENING of Step 2.5d/3h (same predicate, new population, no new assumption A -- so under GOV-SHARPEN-1 a skill edit, not a claim), taking the substrate_queue triple falsifier_requirement_satisfied / event_or_manipulation_produced / dv_or_instrument_exposed as the subject where no what_would_answer exists. NOT MADE here (SKILL.md editing was out of scope) and it carries a GOV-HELDOUT-1 requirement: >=3 historical claim_ids: [] cases where old and new wording give DIFFERENT calls; today's four cases are the motivating set and are NOT admissible, and cases 1-3 are additionally degenerate (they carry claims INV-069/INV-023, so both wordings give the same call). If 3 cannot be found, ship scoped to the single case, as the (a2) 'instantiated is not armed' clause was shipped 2026-09-23. FINDING 2 (the draft claim): V3-EXQ-1075's A3 bar is conv_rel_drop >= 0.99 while its own ARM_OFF control reads 0.98466/0.98486/0.99163 (clears 1 of 3 seeds) -- the bar measures baseline convergence variance, not the manipulation. It passed every shipped gate: Step 2.5d would have traced conv_rel_drop and found it live (it moves 0.028-0.9947 across the ladder), and the metaworker-orchestrate 1d-iii pre-flight axis (c) explicitly LICENSES the citation that justified the bar ('cite a recorded value from a landed manifest' -- V3-EXQ-1073 reached 0.998 at the same P0_STEPS and LR). Draft GOV-CRITBAR-1 (subject governance.epistemics.control_denominated_criterion_threshold, polarity asserts, status candidate, depends_on GOV-UNWRITTEN-1 + GOV-PATHVALID-1) asserts that a threshold criterion's bar must be denominated on the control arm of the RUN THAT WILL BE SCORED AGAINST IT, at its own operating point. Under GOV-SHARPEN-1's C+B vs C+A test this is a DISTINCT claim, not a sharpening of GOV-PATHVALID-1: it needs a new empirical assumption A (the same quantity in another landed manifest can differ materially from this run's own control at this operating point -- measured here, 0.998 vs 0.985), and it guards the opposite half of the causal chain (downstream readout/threshold vs upstream endogenous reachability) against the opposite error (false negative vs PATHVALID's false-positive reporting move). Its falsifier has a real failing clause: a corpus sample of >=20 multi-arm designs showing the control's value is already recorded against the bar as routine practice would refute it -- NOT RUN, and not discharged by anything in the document. FINDING 3 (scoping, stated so this is not over-read): only 3 of the 4 motivating cases are one pattern, and those 3 are ALREADY OWNED -- Step 2.5d refused INV-069 arm (b) by name (GFLAG-0428), and INV-069 behavioural (GFLAG-0414) and INV-023 DV-1 (GFLAG-0415) were caught by campaign pilots. The fourth case contains a SECOND defect of opposite polarity (A1's bare ratio > 1.0 admits a destroyed head: passing ratios 1.0109/1.0026/1.0015 at skill_vs_identity -431/-563/-675) which is recommended NOT to be registered -- it is already covered by the effect-size PASS-gate margin discipline plus CLAUDE.md's cannot-determine category, the 1075 autopsy's instrument finding #1 states the fix, and an open decision chip (chip-decision-20260923-1075a-a1-margin-bar) has the specific threshold in front of the user. Also note Voon 2015 grounds arm 3's DV via a RIVAL mechanism -- habit-system dominance, i.e. forward search being bypassed -- which is behaviourally convergent with but architecturally opposite to the claim's deep-basin-inside-rollout account, so any future arm-3 design needs a second measurement of whether rollout is still coupled to the policy.

items.summary: CDQ-012 (convergence_demand_queue.v1.json) states that the z_world world-forward head 'barely reads its action' (max A1 ratio 1.054) and makes completion criterion (i) 'inverted-rule battery ratio measurably > 1 on a converged head'. Both are measured against 1.0, which is the RANDOM-INIT null on this battery, not the action-blind null. The V3-EXQ-1075a stop handover (ree-v3/.scratch/v3_exq_1075a_stopped/v3_exq_1075a_stop_handover_20260923.md, sec. 'Two facts') measured the copy-the-input blind null at 0.5632/0.5824/0.5063; the trained OFF head sits at 0.8331/0.8790/0.7068, i.e. 0.20-0.30 ABOVE the blind null on 3/3 seeds, so it already reads its action. Because the counterfactual battery is ~45% easier (id_cf ~ 0.56*id_orig), a ratio drifting toward 1.0 is decay toward initialisation, so criterion (i) as written can only be met by a DEGRADING head. Proposed correction: re-denominate (i) on the measured action-blind null, and restate the mechanism gap as whether the action-driven displacement is large enough relative to z_world's small per-step movement for the contradiction-based falsifiers (MECH-574 novel-target arm, intake F3) to be poseable -- the encoder-displacement leg, which the 1075 autopsy says needs a new substrate entry that is still unowned.
items.resolution_note: NOT APPLIED AS DRAFTED -- CORRECTED 2026-09-23 by governance cycle governance-pause-20260923-1741 on confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1079_2026-09-23. The flag is RIGHT that CDQ-012's completion criterion (i) must not be denominated against 1.0 (the random-init null). But its proposed replacement -- re-denominate on 'the measured action-blind null' of 0.5632/0.5824/0.5063 -- rests on a number GFLAG-0434 identified and V3-EXQ-1079 then CONFIRMED to be an EMA warm-up artifact of battery collection ORDER. Against the corrected burn-in null the trained OFF head (0.8331/0.8790/0.7068) sits BELOW, not 0.20-0.30 above, on 3/3 seeds, so the flag's supporting argument inverts. Its CONCLUSION ('the head already reads its action') is separately REGIME-DEPENDENT: on the statistic with an analytic null (d_act) the 0.3 cell reads -0.0762/+0.0556/-0.0321 on the 1075-comparable first 64 rows -- negative on 2 of 3 seeds -- and only turns positive (+0.17/+0.23/+0.24) on the full 512-row battery, which this cycle established is collected from a DEAD agent and drifts along an unbounded accumulator. CORRECTED DISPOSITION: criterion (i) should be denominated on a statistic whose null is ANALYTIC (d_act scores exactly 0 for an action-blind head -- verified in code: _swap_errors averages the ERRORS over the alternative actions, so there is no Jensen term), never on any MEASURED null from this battery, and the battery itself must reset on done before any such criterion is scored. The flag's reframing of the mechanism gap toward the encoder-displacement leg stands and is already owned by SD-PP-B10 (probe_queue_id V3-EXQ-1079, test 1 now resolved).

items.summary: The V3-EXQ-1073/1075 action-blind null (0.5632/0.5824/0.5063) that GFLAG-0432 and the 1075a stop handover's 'Two facts' rest on is an EMA warm-up artifact of battery COLLECTION ORDER at alpha_world 0.3, not a property of the inverted map: the original battery is collected first on a fresh agent and its rows 0-9 carry the z_world EMA relaxing from its initial state (7-10x steady-state displacement); collecting the counterfactual battery first gives 2.26-2.41, excluding rows 0-9 gives 1.08-1.38, and with that removed the trained OFF head (0.83/0.88/0.71) sits BELOW its blind null on 3/3 seeds, so 'the OFF head already reads its action' does not survive; at alpha_world 0.9/1.0 the blind null (1.08-1.34) sits above the random-init null (~1.0) on 6/6 cells, inverting the (blind, init) band. Measured with the landed 1075 driver's own functions; full table in ree-v3/.scratch/alphaworld_probe/DECISION.md sec. 1 (session alphaworld-probe-20260923); bears on GFLAG-0432's proposed correction and on reading the SD-PP-B5 validated-negative.
items.resolution_note: UPHELD AND CONFIRMED AT SOURCE 2026-09-23 by governance cycle governance-pause-20260923-1741, via a purpose-built run (V3-EXQ-1079) and confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1079_2026-09-23 (REE_assembly 18a3306a5b). The flag was right on every measured point. V3-EXQ-1079 reproduces the disputed action-blind null EXACTLY under V3-EXQ-1075's collection order (blind_null_1075_order 0.5632/0.5824/0.5063, matching the flag's figures to 4 d.p.), and shows it is a warm-up/order artifact: collecting the counterfactual battery first gives 2.3397/2.4102/2.2556, and with a burn-in the blind null lands at 1.0404/1.2012/0.9337, on top of the random-init null 1.0063/1.0184/1.0019. At alpha 0.9/1.0 the (blind, init) band inverts as the flag said. Consequence applied: GFLAG-0432 resolved as NOT-APPLICABLE-AS-DRAFTED, SD-PP-B5's validated-negative QUALIFIED (REE_assembly 8673d655da). One thing the flag did not reach, found by this cycle's cross-model red-team and verified independently: the corrected burn-in battery is itself non-stationary because it is collected from a DEAD agent -- health_depleted at step 32/27/22 after env.reset(), the driver never reads done, and world_state accrues without bound. So the right remedy is not a better MEASURED null at all (any measured null on this battery inherits the drift) but a statistic with an ANALYTIC null plus a battery that resets on done.

items.summary: MECH-151 re-read (chip-20260923-mech151-reread, from GFLAG-0402): the GFLAG-0133 no-build ruling (decision B, 2026-09-05) rests on a FALSE factual premise and CONTRADICTS an earlier user ruling. VERDICT FROM SOURCE + LIVE PROBE: the E3 action-object ranking channel is BUILT and has REAL ranking authority, but is INERT AT ITS DEFAULTS and has never been exercised. (1) BUILT: ree-v3 84e211a (2026-09-01, still on main at 4b32e9d) adds e3_selector.compute_action_object_alignment_bias (per-candidate cosine alignment of each Trajectory.action_objects with the SD-016 cue action_bias, negated, lower-is-better) and composes it into dacc_score_bias in REEAgent.select_action (agent.py ~9514), which reaches E3.select as score_bias (agent.py ~9725), where it is added to scores. It is gated by config.e3.use_action_object_bias_channel (default False, bit-identical when off; registered in tests/test_flag_inertness.py) and needs sd016_enabled for a non-None action_bias. It is pinned by tests/contracts/test_gflag0051_action_object_bias_channel.py, but only on hand-built candidates plus a textual guard check; no REEAgent end-to-end test exists. (2) NEVER EXERCISED: no experiment script, queue item or evidence manifest sets the flag. (3) LIVE PROBE (this session, fresh-init REEAgent, sd016_enabled, CausalGridWorldV2 size 8, seeds 7/11, 60 ticks, 7-8 E3 selections per run): at the default weight 1.0 the channel returns a non-None [32] bias on every E3 tick, but its cross-candidate spread is ~0.009 (median) against a raw E3 score range of ~50-100. That is 0 E3 selection flips and 0 action changes at w=1, 10, 100 and 1000, and 4-7 of 7-8 selections flipped (16-32 of 60 actions changed) only at w=1e4-1e5. So the channel has genuine ranking authority, but is roughly 4 orders of magnitude scale-incommensurate at its default weight. That is the E3 channel-commensurability gap GFLAG-0051 said its validation was downstream of (MECH-439 rung-3 operator c47b885, use_e3_channel_commensurability default False; not tested here). (4) CUE-DEGENERATE: the cue action_bias it aligns against is near-constant across ticks (pairwise cosine median 0.9993, min 0.983, n=60), and cue_action_proj is untrained on standard runs because agent.py detaches action_bias (SD-055 refusal record). So even where the weight is large enough to bite, the effect is a fixed-direction action-object preference, not the cue-indexed elevate/suppress MECH-151 asserts. That is the non-degeneracy precondition in MECH-151 what_would_answer, measured here as unmet at init. REGISTRY CONTRADICTIONS OWED A DECISION: (a) GFLAG-0051 resolution records a USER DECISION 2026-09-04 for option (A), channel kept and validation deferred to the commensurability build; GFLAG-0133 records a USER DECISION one day later (2026-09-05) for option (B), qualify and no build, justified by "e3_selector.py has zero action_object/action_bias references", false since 84e211a. (b) claims.yaml MECH-151 carries both at once: evidence_quality_note (2026-09-05) states the CEM refit is the ONLY channel and repeats the false zero-references premise, while what_would_answer (2026-09-22 audit) registers a falsifier ON the built channel. (c) substrate_queue mech151-action-bias-has-no-e3-ranking-channel is wontfix with a title and hint asserting "E3 has no action-object input channel at all". (d) EXP-1311 is blocked_substrate on that entry citing pre-build text and a stale DO_NOT_BUILD_YET status. The CEM-refit channel the qualification describes is still real (agent.py ~6293 -> HippocampalModule). The qualification is not wrong about the refit; it is wrong that the refit is the only channel. Governance to choose: (A) reconcile to the 09-04 ruling -- reopen the entry as built/pending-validation, correct the evidence_quality_note premise, and re-scope EXP-1311 to the what_would_answer design, with the weight calibrated to the E3 score range (or the commensurability operator on) and the cue-variation precondition gated first; or (B) keep the qualification but strike the false premise from MECH-151, retitle the substrate entry, and record the channel as a built, default-off, unvalidated alternative so it is not re-discovered as a contradiction. Probe recipe: fresh REEAgent via REEConfig.from_dims(sd016_enabled=True, use_action_object_bias_channel=True, action_object_bias_weight=w), wrap agent.e3.select, compare selected_index and emitted actions against the flag-off run at a matched seed. No claims.yaml, substrate_queue or experiment_proposals edit made.

items.summary: SD-PP-B1 premise is FALSE as measured against ree-v3 4b32e9d (session infallible-elion-289944, chip-20260923-sdppb1-consumer-probe): e2.world_forward HAS a default-on route to E3 candidate ranking. HippocampalModule proposes candidates through E2FastPredictor.rollout_with_world (hippocampal/module.py:1113,1342,1384,2284,2895,3031), and rollout_with_world calls self.world_forward(z_world, action) at every step (e2_fast.py ~:822); E3 score_trajectory then computes F/M/Phi/benefit/goal over those world_states (e3_selector.py _get_world_states :1301, harm/residue/benefit/goal costs :1334-1444). The necessities doc (precision_provenance_substrate_necessities_20260922.md B1) read the planning path as E1 proposer rollouts and grep-matched only the e3_selector docstring. EMPIRICAL (scratch probe, untrained agent, default config with curiosity OFF and curiosity_candidate_source=proposer, alpha_world 0.9, one seeded E3 tick, K=32): perturbing only e2.world_transition (0.05*randn) changed candidate world_states (max |d| 0.149), changed the CEM-selected candidate action set, and moved the E3 argmin 26->19 (score range 56.3); an unperturbed rebuild was bit-identical (null 0.0). This establishes STRUCTURAL reach only (large perturbation, untrained evaluators), not whether a sleep-sized head change moves ranking. Consequences for governance: (1) the B1 row title/why_no_existing_owner and the Result-4 cap rationale in V3-EXQ-1073 preregistration rest on the false premise and need re-statement; (2) the MECH-572/573/574 and INV-063 leg-B mechanistic-only cap is not justified by absence of a route -- at most by magnitude, which is what the commissioned probe now measures, re-scoped by this session as a route-attributed ranking-shift probe (default proposer-rollout route vs MECH-314a curiosity route, 314a armed in all arms as commissioned).

SUBSTRATE DEFECT, unowned, complicated (buildable): ResidueField.integrate() (ree-v3 ree_core/residue/field.py, the loop after 'noise = torch.randn_like(harm_locations) * self.effective_harm_bandwidth') jitters each sample by an isotropic Gaussian whose PER-DIMENSION std is the kernel bandwidth, so in the production world_dim=32 the sample lies ~sqrt(32)=5.6 kernel widths from its harm location, where the RBF target reads exp(-16): MEASURED target/peak = 4.5e-06 (bw 1.0) and 8.8e-06 (bw 0.15); at world_dim 8 it is 4e-02 and at 2 it is 0.45, so the ratio is bandwidth-invariant and grows with dimension. Consequence: neural_field is distilled toward ~0 everywhere and integrate() does NOTHING except erase the untrained Softplus head's ~0.07 pedestal from evaluate() -- which is exactly GFLAG-0356's 'evaluate() lands on the rbf core to 4 decimals', now explained. MEASURED in a live agent (CausalGridWorldV2 8x8, 400 waking steps, forced sleep cycle through WRITEBACK, mech018_residue_integration_fired=1, trains=1; seeds 42/43 x harm_field_bandwidth None/0.15): evaluate() drop at harm centres vs visited harmless states 0.06296 vs 0.06297, 0.07107 vs 0.07125, 0.05153 vs 0.05161, 0.06263 vs 0.06282 -- identical to 4 decimals, i.e. a pure uniform shift; specificity ratio post equals the pedestal-matched control to 5 decimals on every cell; pairwise harmless-vs-harm rejection rate at evaluate_trajectory unchanged within +/-0.002. So readouts (ii) and (iv) cannot move and any EXP-0755 run returns MECH-018's FALSIFYING branch for a substrate reason. Contract tests/contracts/test_mech018_residue_integrate_gradient.py is BLIND to it: it builds world_dim=8 fields, where targets are 4 percent of peak and 'loss falls / params move' passes. Build ask: sample integrate() targets from the harm field's support (e.g. per-dim std = bandwidth/sqrt(world_dim), or draw from recorded visited z_world), plus a contract at world_dim=32 asserting mean target/peak above a floor. Needs a substrate_queue.json row (unblocks_claims MECH-018, pending_retest_after_substrate) and an /implement-substrate chip; this session chips it. Note for the eventual pre-registration: readout (i) against the rbf core is STRUCTURALLY guaranteed (neural_field ends in Softplus>=0 and the optimizer is isolated from rbf_field), so it cannot fail in the integration arm and must be scored non-degenerate:false there; only the naive-decay arm can fail it.

items.summary: MECH-018 needs a decision BEFORE the GFLAG-0441 sampling fix is worth building for this claim: even with integrate() correctly distilling, its OBJECTIVE cannot produce the contextualisation the claim asserts, so readouts (ii) SPECIFICITY and (iv) harmless-region proposal rejection stay unreachable by construction -- the same shape as the readout (iii) centre-merge question GFLAG-0356/0366 settled by narrowing. Arithmetic, from ree-v3 ree_core/residue/field.py: integrate() trains neural_field toward rbf_field targets, and the waking consumer reads evaluate()/evaluate_trajectory() = rbf + 0.1*neural. A converged distillation therefore makes the read 1.1 x the rbf core, and a harm/harmless ratio and any rank-based choice are invariant under that positive rescaling, so post-integration specificity EQUALS the no-integration rbf core's own specificity; the only change from the pre-integration read is removal of the untrained Softplus head's roughly-constant pedestal, which is exactly what GFLAG-0356's pedestal-matched control absorbs. No information about harmless contexts enters integrate() at all (targets are rbf values at jittered harm locations), so there is no signal it could contextualise with. Options: (a) NARROW MECH-018 further to the readouts the substrate can express -- (i) preservation vs naive decay and (iii) approximation error at a declared budget -- and record that (ii)/(iv) are unowned; or (b) commission a contextualisation objective (e.g. a residual head trained on visited harmless states so neural adds at harm and not at harmless contexts; note Softplus>=0 means it can only ADD residue, never subtract over-generalisation from the core). Declared budget fact for (iii): neural_field is ~6.4k params (32->64->64->1) vs 32 active RBF centres x 33 = 1,056, so the 'fewer parameters' reading of compression does not hold either. Raised by the EXP-0755 /queue-experiment session, which queued nothing (GFLAG-0441).

items.summary:
INV-063's C2 -- the load-bearing knee that distinguishes this claim from INV-050 -- carries NO guard against the knee being produced by MEL rung SPACING rather than by starvation of offline function, and the knee pattern is already present in the manipulation check before any DV is read. NO claims.yaml edit proposed here; nothing applied.

THE GAP. P1 constrains the intake ladder's MONOTONICITY and TOTAL SPREAD; it says nothing about SPACING. So C2 on leg A currently asks whether the four world_rule_shift_interval values {10, 25, 60, 0} happen to be spaced with a larger MEL step at the low end. Under either outcome nobody can say whether "offline function has a floor" or "interval 60->0 is simply a bigger MEL step than 10->25".

THE MEASUREMENT that makes it concrete (from V3-EXQ-1071's Step 4.5 red-team, recorded in REE_assembly/evidence/planning/inv063_legA_dv_circularity_20260920.md): applying V3-EXQ-1071's OWN _knee rule to V3-EXQ-1069's LANDED per-seed MELs already yields knee=True on seed 456 (excess 9.6e-6 against a 9.4e-6 margin), and False on seeds 42 and 123. That is a knee in the manipulation-check scalar itself, with no dependent variable involved.

WHY THIS IS UNRECORDED RIGHT NOW. GFLAG-0389 raised the leg-A DV circularity and the C2 spacing corollary together. The 2026-09-21/22 falsifier completion and runnability audit (REE_assembly 02caebd047f) rewrote INV-063's what_would_answer and carried the LEG-A half forward -- the NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION now requires leg A to be re-registered with a DV independent of e3_prediction_error, and names the replay start-selection composition as a candidate -- but it did NOT carry the C2 spacing corollary. The 2026-09-22 leg-B cycle explicitly left "C2's knee margin" untouched. Verified 2026-09-24: the token "spacing" appears nowhere in claims.yaml, and the C2 concern survives only in the planning doc above. The FALSIFYING branch still reads "the degradation is a slope rather than a knee" with no spacing guard behind it.

WHAT IS ASKED OF /governance. When leg A is re-registered with an independent DV (owed work already recorded on this claim), C2 must be handled at the same time, in one of two ways, and NOT left implicit:
  (i) REGISTER A SPACING CONTROL -- the knee must survive on a DV demonstrably not a transform of e3_prediction_error, PLUS a stated check that the MEL ladder itself is not already knee-shaped at the same pre-registered margin on the same seeds; or
  (ii) AMEND OR NARROW C2 EXPLICITLY, saying to what.
Recommendation is (i): the check is arithmetic on data V3-EXQ-1069 has already landed, so it costs no experiment budget, and (ii) weakens the only criterion that separates INV-063 from INV-050.

SCOPE / NOT CHANGED. Status stays candidate; epistemic_category stays substrate_conditional (the GFLAG-0390 conversion is NOT reversed); confidence, the literature entries and the non_contributory dispositions of V3-EXQ-1063 and V3-EXQ-1069 are untouched. No experiment is queued and the V3-EXQ-1071 driver (ree-v3 origin/main 9700362aa5) stays UNQUEUED and reusable. Registration is not build authorisation. This flag records a gap in a criterion; it does not propose replacement leg-A DV text.

PROVENANCE AND A CORRECTION TO THE SPAWNING CHIP. Raised from chip-20260921-inv063-lega-dv-reregistration, whose broader deliverable (a full staged leg-A DV re-registration proposal) is SUPERSEDED IN PART by 02caebd047f and was scoped down by the user on 2026-09-24 to this flag alone. Two premises in that chip are corrected here rather than propagated: (1) its STOP-CHECK treats the absence of the string "count of VALENCE_SURPRISE residue writes" from claims.yaml as proof that leg A was re-registered -- the string is absent because 02caebd047f rewrote what_would_answer wholesale, and leg A still has no operational DV; (2) it specified flag-type contested_disposition, which per this registry's own definition means two sessions or a session and the user reached different conclusions -- no such disagreement exists here, so this is filed as evidence_discrepancy, matching the GFLAG-0407 precedent (a measured number showing a registered requirement does not implement what it states).
items.resolution_note:
SUPERSEDED BY GFLAG-0446, which carries this concern in a more complete form. Raised 2026-09-24T07:04:26Z; superseded the same day after verifying the landed artifact. Not withdrawn -- the gap was real and is unfixed in the LIVE registry; what changed is that a better-specified remedy now owns it, and two open flags on one claim invite /governance to double-handle one item.

WHAT SUPERSEDES IT. REE_assembly f6cc06142f (verified on origin/master), evidence/planning/inv063_legA_dv_reregistration_proposal_20260920.md, raised as GFLAG-0446 by session inv063-lega-dv-rereg-20260921 at 07:09:35Z. Its EDIT 3 moves C2's abscissa from ARM INDEX to MEASURED MEL (local secants), so the criterion becomes DV change per unit of measured waking MEL. That is a better answer than either remedy this flag proposed: it does not add a spacing control alongside the knee, it removes the spacing degree of freedom from the criterion itself. It also independently reproduces this flag's own measurement -- knee=True on V3-EXQ-1069 seed 456 from MEL alone, excess 9.605e-06 against margin 9.402e-06 -- and, going further than this flag did, REJECTS the extrapolation form of the spacing control on measurement (gap/span 0.060 / 1.639 / 1.562, extrapolation exceeding the fitted span on 2 of 3 seeds).

TWO CAVEATS CARRIED FORWARD, found auditing f6cc06142f and recorded here because that document does not state them. Neither changes its verdict; both bear on how /governance should read EDIT 3.
(1) THE SPACING FIX IS STRUCTURAL, NOT EMPIRICAL. The per-unit-MEL abscissa removes the confound BY CONSTRUCTION only for a DV that is affine in MEL -- for such a DV both secants equal the same constant and the excess is identically zero. Whether the actual A1'/A2' is near-affine in MEL is untested, and testing it is exactly the empirical non-co-movement test (Test 2) that the same document correctly registers as OWED and cannot discharge from landed data (V3-EXQ-1069 fired no sleep pass, sleep_driver_pattern "none"; no landed run records the leg-A shim keys). So EDIT 3 should be read as closing the spacing degree of freedom in the CRITERION, with the empirical question deferred to the first A1'/A2'-measuring run -- not as having measured the confound away.
(2) AN UNSTATED GATING PREMISE IN THE INDEPENDENCE ARGUMENT. That document's scale-invariance argument rests on drive_state[VALENCE_SURPRISE] being min(1.0, _pe_ema * 5.0), and it explicitly verifies valence_harm_enabled / valence_liking_enabled default False -- but it does not state that this form is itself CONDITIONAL. At ree-v3 ree_core/agent.py:10981-10986 surprise_weight defaults to the CONSTANT 0.3 and only becomes min(1.0, _pe_ema * 5.0) when config.surprise_gated_replay is True AND _pe_ema > 0. The conclusion still holds for this claim, by two independent routes: INV-063's own P4 already requires surprise_gated_replay=True, and V3-EXQ-1071's driver sets it at experiments/v3_exq_1071_inv063_four_arm_intake_ladder.py:351. Worth noting rather than silent, because in the False branch the weight is a constant and therefore NOT a MEL transform at all -- so the independence problem this whole re-registration exists to solve is specifically a property of the P4-pinned regime, which is a sharper statement than the document makes.

NO claims.yaml edit from this flag; none was ever proposed by it. Applying GFLAG-0446 discharges this flag's substance; nothing further is owed to it.

items.summary:
STAGED, READY-TO-APPLY RE-REGISTRATION OF INV-063 C1 LEG A, discharging the owed work GFLAG-0389/GFLAG-0390 recorded on the evidence_quality_note. NO claims.yaml edit; nothing applied; no experiment queued; the V3-EXQ-1071 driver stays UNQUEUED at ree-v3 9700362aa5. Full proposal: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/inv063_legA_dv_reregistration_proposal_20260920.md (landed f6cc06142f, verified on origin/master).

PREMISE CORRECTION FIRST, because it changes what is being proposed: the three circular leg-A DVs are ALREADY GONE from what_would_answer -- governance rewrote the field between 2026-09-21 and 2026-09-23 (GFLAG-0394 applied, (P-FAIL) registered retroactively 2026-09-22, GFLAG-0407/MECH-573 skill-score clause added), and GFLAG-0389/0390/0394 are all resolved. What the live text now carries is a PLACEHOLDER -- "Leg A needs a replacement offline-function DV independent of e3_prediction_error -- a candidate is the replay start-selection composition" -- and nothing in the registry supplies the operational DV. This proposal supplies it, and is independent of the leg-B wording proposal rather than needing to compose with it. Each of its three target strings occurs exactly once on origin/master and is disjoint from the leg-B sentence and the (P-FAIL) clause.

THREE PROPOSED EDITS. (1) Replace the leg-A DV placeholder with a COMPOSITION-ONLY DV set: admissible leg-A statistics are functions of the SELECTED INDICES only. Primary A1' = total-variation distance between the live selected-index histogram and the histogram the same argmax rule returns on the same recorded priority vectors with the VALENCE_SURPRISE drive weight zeroed (falls to 0 exactly when surprise gating makes no difference to which episode is replayed -- the registered intent). Secondary A2' = modal share and normalised entropy of the selected-index histogram, with the DIRECTION CORRECTED: under an argmax selector, losing the signal CONCENTRATES selection on the tie-break index, so entropy falls and modal share rises as intake falls -- the opposite of the prose the claim carried until 2026-09-20. Rejected as inadmissible: every priority-MAGNITUDE statistic (the max-minus-min spread registered as A3, any share of priority mass, any Gini or entropy over normalised priorities), and the priority-vs-PE rank correlation, which is scale-invariant but reads PE as a variable and so cannot discharge independence -- record it as a diagnostic only. (2) Append P6 (the selection instrument must be RESOLVED, not tied: assert distinct-float count > 1 and argmax-to-runner-up gap above the float32 ulp at the epsilon floor, 1.19e-13 measured, plus >= 30 replay calls per arm-period -- starvation is precisely what drives the signal toward the floor, so the instrument would die first in the arm the claim needs) and P7 (the two MEL steps C2 divides by must each exceed the per-seed monotonicity tolerance P1 already computes; failure is (P-FAIL), never the FALSIFYING branch). (3) Move C2's abscissa from arm INDEX to measured MEL (local secants: DV change per unit MEL between the two lowest arms vs the two highest, same SD-scaled margin convention).

INDEPENDENCE CRITERION, TEST 1 (SCALE INVARIANCE) RUN against the live code path at ree-v3 origin/main 4fc6f3d. Mechanism re-verified: _select_valence_weighted_start (hippocampal/module.py:3036) returns the ARGMAX of get_valence_priority with tie-break toward the first index (module.py:3062/3073); priority = dot(valence, drive) + epsilon, epsilon = 1e-6 (residue/field.py:988); drive[VALENCE_SURPRISE] = min(1, _pe_ema*5) (agent.py:10986/11010) and _pe_ema is an EMA of the same e3 prediction_error republished as metrics["e3_prediction_error"] at agent.py:11064; with valence_harm_enabled and valence_liking_enabled default-False (config.py:3904-3905) and unset by this lineage's builder, the dot reduces to A2*v + epsilon, so the MEL dependence is ONE positive scalar on the whole vector. MEASURED on a bench probe using the real ResidueField at V3-EXQ-1069's MEL write scale: argmax = 7 and top-3 ordering [7,1,9] UNCHANGED across rescalings c in {1e-3, 1e-2, 0.1, 10} and across surprise weights 8e-05..1.0, while the top-of-mass share moves 0.0835288624 -> 0.0863241877 under c alone, and the old A3 spread scales linearly with the weight (3.452e-10 at s=8e-05 to 4.314e-06 at s=1, factor 1.25e4 for an s ratio of 1.25e4 -- GFLAG-0389's finding quantified). Additionally, at measured scale A2*v ~ 4.26e-09 against epsilon = 1e-6, so the additive floor exceeds the signal ~235x and every mass share is pinned at 1/T = 0.0833 with normalised entropy 0.99999999: a mass-family DV would have been a constant dressed as a measurement. Verdict per candidate is stated explicitly in the proposal, and the two composition DVs are the only ones that pass.

TEST 2 (EMPIRICAL NON-CO-MOVEMENT) NOT RUN, REGISTERED AS OWED rather than invented. V3-EXQ-1069 cannot supply it: its manifest carries sleep_driver_pattern "none (no sleep pass is configured or fired)" and its scope_note says it measures the P1 manipulation check and nothing else, so there are no replay calls and no priority or selection fields in its 12 cells; and a search of evidence/experiments for the leg-A shim's own output keys (a3_replay_priority_spread, a3_start_selection_entropy) returns no landed run at all, because the driver that records them has never been queued. The check is registered on the first run that measures A1'/A2', to be reported BEFORE that run's C1/C2 verdict is read.

C2 IS ALSO PROTECTED, which a leg-A fix alone does not do. V3-EXQ-1071's own _knee rule applied to V3-EXQ-1069's LANDED MELs, with MEL itself as the DV, already yields knee=True on seed 456 (excess 9.605e-06 against a 9.402e-06 margin; False on 42 and 123) -- a knee verdict available from the manipulation check with no DV read. The ladder's spacing is the reason: within seed 456 the adjacent MEL steps differ 36x (1.633e-05 / 3.728e-06 / 6.729e-06), and P1 constrains monotonicity and total spread but says nothing about spacing. The extrapolation form of a spacing control (fit DV against MEL on the three highest arms, test the floor arm's shortfall) is REJECTED on measurement: the extrapolation distance exceeds the fitted span on 2 of 3 seeds (gap/span 0.060 / 1.639 / 1.562). The local-secant form is proposed instead, because for any DV affine in MEL both secants are equal and the excess is identically zero regardless of spacing -- the artefact is removed by construction, not by margin tuning. Its conditioning is exactly P7, and on the landed ladder all three seeds clear it, but seed 42's low-end denominator clears by only 1.12x (4.494e-07 against tolerance 4.03e-07), which is why P7 is a precondition with a (P-FAIL) consequence rather than a footnote.

DECISION ASKED OF GOVERNANCE: apply edits 1+2 together (edit 1 alone would register an invariance guarantee with nothing asserting it), and either apply edit 3 or narrow C2 explicitly and record that a confirmed C2 is not attributable to the DV. Leaving the arm-index knee rule standing alongside a fixed leg A is the one combination the proposal argues against. NOT proposed and NOT in scope: reversing the substrate_conditional conversion (GFLAG-0390 stands), queueing anything, or fixing the three V3-EXQ-1071 driver defects recorded in inv063_legA_dv_circularity_20260920.md section 3 (ungated P1 sub-controls that the smoke shows WOULD fire, the all-four-arms AND refusal route, and need computed from len(seeds) rather than scored seeds), which stay /queue-experiment work on an unqueued driver with no budget.

MECH-064 principle-vs-mechanism (chip-20260919-mech064-principle-not-mechanism; lit REE_assembly 94286de2a93, targeted_review_mech_064): Beurer-Kellner 2025 lists six inequivalent patterns that all satisfy MECH-064's authority-separation principle with different guarantees, so the title/prose can be met by the weakest one; Wallace 2024 shows channel-derived ORDERING and its ENFORCEMENT separate (trained ordering = probabilistic prior, not a denial), so 'runtime-enforced' is load-bearing; Zhan 2025 breaks 8 content-derived defences at >50% ASR under adaptive attack while MECH-064 itself has never been adversarially evaluated; and its allowed/forbidden path table (docs/architecture/control_plane_signal_map.md#mech-064) is unchecked prose. Premise re-measured: the current what_would_answer ALREADY names one mechanism family (runtime denial at a typed POL/ID/CAPS store-write boundary, spoofed-label vs trusted-channel manipulation, DV unauthorised durable writes) but the title does not, it has no adaptive-attack clause, and it states the guarantee as absolute. RECOMMENDATION (A): narrow MECH-064 IN PLACE, no split -- commit the title to runtime provenance-keyed denial at the store-write boundary (capability-propagation family, CaMeL-shaped), keep 'runtime-enforced' explicit, restate the guarantee as conditional on the boundary enumeration being correct, add an adaptive-attack falsifier (attacker optimises against the deployed gate; any unauthorised durable write falsifies) plus an owed competence-cost measurement (reachable behaviours removed), and record that the path table becomes a checked artifact only once the typed stores exist (EXP-0804 blocked_substrate; ree_core has no POL/ID/CAPS vocabulary per V3-EXQ-1052). Alternatives: (B) split into a principle claim and a mechanism claim; (C) leave as-is with the under-specification stated in notes. No status change; no experiment.

MECH-288's what_would_answer non-degeneracy preconditions are stale in two places and the claim cannot be tested in-agent as written. (1) Precondition (1) requires boundary fires > 0 on BOTH scales; MEASURED 2026-09-24 on ree-cloud-4, the slow/outer BOCPD scale -- the only specificity-bearing scale, and the one primary criterion C1 is defined on -- fires ZERO times on the agent observation path, in both the default config (goal.z_goal_enabled defaults False at ree_core/goal.py:88, so agent.goal_state is None at agent.py:3522-3525 and latent_dict['z_goal'] is None every tick, 0/236) and with z_goal_enabled=True (z_goal supplied 499/499 ticks but identically the zero vector, zgoal_norm_std 0.0, because GoalState's benefit gate never opened; 0 slow fires). This converges with V3-EXQ-830, which got zero slow fires on a LIVE varying z_goal stream at zgoal_norm_std 0.070, and with V3-EXQ-757 needing hand-planted gaps >= 10 to fire the rail. (2) Precondition (3)'s '~15% construction floor' for the fast/inner scale, which C3 is told to use as its chance baseline, measures 0.4% in-agent (2 fires / 499 ticks) -- it is a property of 757's synthetic stream, not the observation stream. SEPARATELY, CONFIRMING (b) still cites V3-EXQ-757's C288_silence (27 A-slow vs 0 B-slow) as C2's pre-registered FP ceiling, but the confirmed D1 cluster autopsy applied in 2e6fe97c4b (2026-09-24T10:23:06Z) found that silence to be by construction ('smooth-arm silence follows from 0.02 noise far below the rail'; verified: GOAL_NOISE=0.02 vs planted gaps >= 10), so the ceiling has no valid anchor. Full measurement record: evidence/planning/mech288_exp1388_inagent_slow_scale_liveness_20260924.md. Consequence: proposal EXP-1388 as designed cannot measure its own primary criterion; it is left at status proposed pending decision chip chip-20260924-mech288-slow-scale-inert.

MECH-439's CONFIRMING branch is UNREACHABLE BY CONSTRUCTION in the operator-ON regime, so the governance-2026-09-24 named follow-on (a redesigned conversion falsifier with use_e3_channel_commensurability ON) cannot be graded against the registered text. PROPOSAL: restate the branch for that regime only. PREMISE RE-MEASURED 2026-09-24: the current what_would_answer conjunct is "committed-action-class entropy stays flat ... WHILE F's cross-candidate variance share stays above 0.85"; with the operator ON, each channel's per-candidate term is divided by an EMA of its own cross-candidate SD, so shares tend to 1/k by construction (GFLAG-0234 arithmetic identity, confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1012c_2026-09-24 sec 2: "unreachable by construction"). 571c additionally found the fed-regime monopolist is residue_weighted, not F. PROPOSED RESTATEMENT, scoped to use_e3_channel_commensurability=True only (the registered text is preserved verbatim for the operator-OFF regime). (i) NON-DEGENERACY, substituted operationalisation: the ">= 2 channels carrying non-trivial cross-candidate variance SHARE" precondition is replaced by the ratified eligibility-stage target R_ON = min_c J_c / max_c J_c >= 0.25 in >= 3 of 4 seeds per regime, J_c the tick-mean Jaccard distance between the margin-eligible set E and E with channel c knocked out, with same-tick OFF and ORACLE anchors (governance 2026-09-24; V3-EXQ-1012c 8/8 cells >= 0.408). (ii) CONFIRMING: with the operator ON and that gate MET on the same ticks the DV is read, committed-action-class entropy LIFTS strict-above BOTH the collapsed-proposer and the matched-noise control on >= 3 of 4 seeds in BOTH the residue-fed and residue-starved regimes -- i.e. rebalancing the score-scale monopoly is what releases the ceiling, which is the claim's own causal conditional ("cannot convert ... while F dominates ... unless F's variance share is itself rebalanced"). (iii) FALSIFYING: entropy stays FLAT while that gate is MET -- the monopoly was removed at the stage the claim names and the ceiling did not move, so the F-variance monopoly is not the operative cap; routes to the reserved final-commit-stage locus, not to a further eligibility-stage lever. COMPETING READING the user must choose between: (B) MECH-439's own Consumer/boundary field names "the final committed argmin in e3_selector.py", and the operator acts only at the eligibility stage, so on that reading MECH-439 predicts FLAT even under ON and the map in (ii)/(iii) is INVERTED. RECOMMENDATION: reading (A) as written, because the mechanism sentence is a causal conditional on F's variance share and the operator is the only built lever that moves it, and because under (B) a CONFIRMING result is indistinguishable from an inert manipulation whereas under (A) both cells are informative. Note the choice does NOT change what is measured: the two criteria (entropy lift vs both controls; R_ON at bar) are identical under either reading, so the map can be ratified before or after the run without re-running anything. SCOPE LIMITS to carry with the restatement: eligibility stage only (the within-E final argmin is untouched, so a FLAT cell does not by itself separate "no cap" from "cap at the final-commit stage"); 3 content channels only (f, harm, residue -- benefit and goal read 0 content ticks in this regime); `ready` on f_dominance_conversion_ceiling STAYS false (depends_on_unresolved SD-018 field-head validation and SD-e1 var-bar re-registration untouched). NOT proposed: any status, confidence, epistemic_category or ceiling_decision change; reading V3-EXQ-1012c as MECH-439 evidence; another lettered MECH-439 retest on the same substrate. Raised by the governance-2026-09-24 named follow-on chip chip-20260924-mech439-operator-on-falsifier; the new EXQ implementing (ii)/(iii) is queued in the same session and cites this flag as its ratification dependency.

No artifact in this lineage has ever routed on this ratio (1073 measured and self-routed unposeable; 1079 records it and states it 'does not gate', driver line 759). Queueing STOPPED before any EXQ id was consumed; criterion choice is a user call.
